title: 3D Artist
description:
Paper Trail is a new narrated documentary channel covering financial fraud and corporate scandal (Ponzi schemes, accounting fraud, cover-ups, market manipulation), in the Hoog / Fern / Jake Tran mold.



Role summary: Owns the channel's 3D pipeline — modeling, texturing, lighting, and rendering every video's animated visuals — and builds out Paper Trail's reusable 3D asset library.



What you'll do:

- Model, texture, light, and render every 3D scene/animation a video's shot list calls for.

- Build and maintain a reusable asset library — recurring environments and props the channel needs across most stories (boardroom, courtroom, generic office, city/airport-style exteriors, data-viz set pieces) — so future videos aren't built from zero.

- Work inside the channel's visual system.

- Hand off full source project files plus every linked asset, and revise through review rounds based on feedback.



What we're looking for:

- Mid-to-senior 3D generalist, comfortable across modeling, texturing/lighting, and rendering, not just one stage of the pipeline.

- Portfolio should show restrained, stylized work (clean minimalist scenes, deliberate palette control) rather than maximalist — that's the register this channel runs in.

- Precision executing someone else's brief matters more here than freeform concepting, since the whole channel's visual identity depends on consistency across videos.

- Bonus: experience building modular, reusable 3D asset libraries for ongoing production, not just one-off hero shots.



Software knowledge we're looking for:

- Blender

- Cinema 4D

- Frame.io

- Notion

- Bonus: Adobe Premiere Pro

- Bonus: Adobe After Effects

title: Video Editor & Motion Designer
description:
Role summary: Owns everything from rough cut to final assembly — cutting narration-driven long-form video, building 2D motion graphics and text animations, and handling music/sound design — for Paper Trail's fraud & scandal documentaries.



Paper Trail is a new narrated documentary channel covering financial fraud and corporate scandal (Ponzi schemes, accounting fraud, cover-ups, market manipulation), in the Hoog / Fern / Jake Tran mold.



What you'll do:

- Assemble rough cuts from a shot list, voice over and editing notes and provided 3D assets into a finished edit.

- Build the 2D side of the Paper Trail visual language: kinetic text animations for on-screen callouts and data points, lower-thirds, and any explainer-style 2D graphics (charts, timelines, maps).

- Handle music selection/mixing and sound design from the channel's licensed library — driving the tension/release pacing the format runs on.

- Sourcing relevant archival b-rolls online.

- Work directly from the script's flagged visual cues and the shot list.

- Take a cut through multiple review rounds, incorporating notes until it's locked for publish.

- Help build reusable templates (title card, lower-third, text-animation presets) as the channel's asset library matures.



What we're looking for:

- Mid-to-senior editor with real narrative pacing sense for narrated long-form documentary, not short-form or vlog editing. Portfolio should show that register.

- Can both cut long-form and build 2D motion graphics in After Effects.  This is one combined role, not an editor plus a separate motion person.

- A sound design instinct — using music and SFX to build tension rather than leaning on stock drop-ins.

- Comfortable respecting the channel's visual identity consistently (from an animation to the next, from one video to the next).

- Always eager to improve and learn.



Software knowledge we're looking for:

- Adobe Premiere Pro

- Adobe After Effects

- Frame.io

- Notion

We're live on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, ApeChain, BSC, Abstract, and Monad, with integrations running on Camelot DEX, HELLO DEX, and PancakeSwap. See it yourself: 



𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗢𝗣𝗣𝗢𝗥𝗧𝗨𝗡𝗜𝗧𝗬



Every successful introduction that leads to a partnership earns you serious money. One good partnership can be worth $5,000-10,000+ as it grows.



𝗖𝗢𝗠𝗣𝗘𝗡𝗦𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡



Base Pay: $10/hour, 10 hours/week ($100/week). Paid 50% in Ethereum (ETH) and 50% in $GMI tokens on an 18-month vesting schedule, building you a long-term position in the multi-chain $GMI ecosystem.



Minimum Requirement: 1 qualified appointment per week. A qualified appointment means a scheduled call that actually takes place between me and a decision-maker (founder, BD lead, or marketing head) at a crypto launchpad, DEX, chain, or established project, and meets our qualification criteria. Your first qualified appointment each week is covered by your base pay. All appointments and outreach are logged in our tracker; unlogged work doesn't count or pay.



Appointment Bonus: Every additional qualified appointment beyond the first pays $100, split 50% ETH and 50% $GMI (same vesting).



Commission: 20% of ALL upgrade fees generated by each of your partnerships during its first 180 days live. Our 4-level upgrade system means every user your partnership brings in can pay upgrade fees multiple times, and you earn on every single one during your commission window.



Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through each of your partnerships during its first 180 days live. No ceiling.



Commission is paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



Together with our referral program, we give nearly all of our upgrade revenue back to the people who grow the protocol. Every partnership you land gets its own fresh 180-day earning window.



𝗪𝗛𝗔𝗧 𝗧𝗛𝗜𝗦 𝗟𝗢𝗢𝗞𝗦 𝗟𝗜𝗞𝗘 𝗜𝗡 𝗥𝗘𝗔𝗟 𝗠𝗢𝗡𝗘𝗬 (𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽):



Mints $50,000 in bonds: $1,500 launch bonus paid as it happens, plus 20% of every upgrade fee as they roll in

Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



That's ONE introduction. Land three and run the math.



Note: A successful partnership means a project you introduced signs the LP Bonds integration agreement and goes live on our marketplace. You book the qualified call, I run the deal and close it.



𝗬𝗢𝗨 𝗛𝗔𝗩𝗘:



Existing connections in crypto (launchpads, DEXs, chains, established projects)

/
 relationships with project founders or marketing heads

Understanding of DeFi/crypto space

Hunger to earn based on results, not hours



𝗬𝗢𝗨 𝗗𝗢𝗡'𝗧 𝗡𝗘𝗘𝗗:



To close deals (I handle that)

Any upfront investment

Previous BD experience (connections matter more)



𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗥𝗢𝗟𝗘:



Your job is booking qualified calls. You reach into your network, find decision-makers at crypto projects, and get them on a scheduled call with me. I close the deals, you collect appointment bonuses, commissions, and launch bonuses as your partnerships go live and grow.



Ready to turn your crypto connections into serious income?



𝗔𝗣𝗣𝗟𝗬 𝗪𝗜𝗧𝗛:



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the word BONDS

List 3-5 crypto projects/launchpads you have connections with

Your
 handle

title: DeFi Partnerships Manager: Run the Reps, Book the Calls, Earn Uncapped Overrides
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

- 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

- Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call



𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀



Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.



𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆



Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. IMPORTANT: Your subject line must start with BOND OPS.

2. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

3. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

4. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

5. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

6. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.

title: Media Buyer (Facebook Ads / Instagram Ads)
description:
About This Role



We are a fast-growing US-based e-commerce brand looking for a meticulous, highly reliable media buyer.



In this role, you will not be responsible for high-level creative strategy, copywriting, or video editing. Instead, your primary mission is flawless execution: taking prepared creative assets, copy, and campaign parameters, and setting them up inside Meta Ads Manager exactly according to our established standard operating procedures (SOPs).



We hold an exceptionally high standard for precision. We expect zero errors when it comes to naming conventions, targeting parameters, UTM tracking links, budget allocation, and asset assignments.





Key Responsibilities



- Build, publish, and schedule ad campaigns, ad sets, and ads inside Meta Ads Manager strictly adhering to our SOPs.



- Accurately copy and paste ad copy, headlines, creative assets (images/videos), and destination URLs.



- Ensure 100% precision on tracking parameters, UTM tags, conversion event selections, and pixel configurations.



- Follow structured campaign, ad set, and ad naming conventions without deviations.



- Perform pre-launch quality assurance (QA) checks to verify links, aspect ratios, placements, and budgets before publishing.



- Monitor ad approval status and promptly flag any rejected ads or account notices to the team.



- Keep tracking sheets updated in real time.





Requirements



- Proven Meta Ads Manager Experience: Direct, hands-on experience setting up and launching campaigns inside
 Ads Manager.



-Ecommerce Experience: Have ran ads specifically for DTC ecommerce brands.



- Extreme Attention to Detail: A natural habit of double-checking your work. You take pride in catching tiny discrepancies before anything goes live.



- Process-Driven Mindset: Ability to follow detailed checklists and step-by-step documentation without cutting corners or guessing.



- Reliable Internet & Workstation: A stable high-speed internet connection and backup solution to ensure consistent, uninterrupted work.



- Communication: Clear, prompt written English for status updates and asking questions whenever something in the brief looks ambiguous.



- Availability: Overlap with US business hours for communication, coordination, and urgent launches.





To Apply, Let Us Know:



- Describe your direct experience setting up campaigns inside Meta Ads Manager.



- What is the largest monthly ad spend budget you have DIRECTLY managed?



- What ecommerce brands have you worked with?

title: YouTube Video Editor
description:
We’re looking for a fast, creative, and detail-oriented YouTube Video Editor to help produce high-performing content for a personal brand. This role is focused on creating engaging long-form YouTube videos that retain attention, tell strong stories, and help grow the channel consistently.

title: UGC & VSL Video Editor with Strong AI Video Skills
description:
You started as a video editor. You know Premiere, CapCut, or DaVinci inside out, and you've cut plenty of ads. Then AI video tools arrived, and instead of ignoring them you made them part of how you work. That combination is exactly what we need.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand in the health supplement niche. Paid social is one of our main growth channels, so for us video creative is one of the biggest drivers of the business, not just "content". We're hiring a full-time (40 hours per week) AI video maker and editor to produce high-performing ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels.



THE EDITING SIDE

You'll take scripts, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes, and turn them into polished ads ready for testing:

-
 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos that grab attention quickly and drive purchases

- UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

- Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits showing the product in action

- Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits built from reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

- VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos structured around education and direct response

- Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures



THE AI SIDE

When there's no footage to work with, you generate it yourself:

- AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide

- Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

- HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation

- ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover

- Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video

- At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools. Occasional use doesn't count, and neither does just experimenting.



WE'D ALSO LIKE TO SEE

- Meta/Facebook ad creatives in your portfolio

- Short-form paid social videos

- Long-form VSLs or sales videos

- Strong captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

- Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools

- As a bonus, previous work in the health supplement niche



HOW WE JUDGE AN EDIT

A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action. We are not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We want someone fluent in direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative. Every ad should:

- Stop people in the first 1 to 3 seconds

- Make the problem feel real and urgent

- Show the product clearly and persuasively

- Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

- Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

- Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

- Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

- Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase



Creative that sells doesn't mean ugly or low quality. It means every editing choice supports the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

- Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

- Editing with music, voiceover, sound effects, transitions, and subtitles

- Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs

- Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen

- Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts

- Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield

- Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

- Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

- Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

- Uploading finished videos to Google Drive, clearly named and organized

- Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

- Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations



YOU'RE THE RIGHT PERSON IF YOU

- Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

- Have hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools

- Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

- Can create multiple ad variations quickly

- Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

- Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

- Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

- Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

- Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good



WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US

- Competitive compensation based on experience

- The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue

- Clear creative direction and fast feedback

- Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively, for someone who wants more responsibility over time



We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for someone who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.

Schedule appointments while ensuring that the patient's "important person" (IP), such as a significant other or key individual in their life, is involved. mbers and office staff to ensure a smooth and efficient workflow. Foster a positive and professional environment for everyone involved.



- Create a Fun, Positive Experience: While the work is serious, your attitude doesn’t have to be. Enjoy your role, and let that enjoyment carry over into your interactions, making the experience for everyone as positive as possible.



- Training & Support: We provide comprehensive training to ensure your success in this role. You will be equipped with a detailed video curriculum, including step-by-step Loom videos and documentation, to guide you through handling phone calls and other responsibilities as we expect. Our training is designed to set you up for success by making sure you’re comfortable and confident in your role.



Compensation:



- Base Pay: The position offers a competitive base salary.

- Bonus Structure: In addition to the base pay, you will be eligible for performance-based bonuses:

- Bonuses for the number of outbound leads that you schedule who show up for their appointment.

- Additional bonuses for leads who attend with their "important person" (IP).

- Further bonuses for leads from outbound calls/reach-outs who sign up for care.





Required Skills & Qualifications:



- Strong communication and customer service skills.

- Ability to empathize with patients who may be experiencing significant pain or discomfort.

- Experience with CRM systems, scheduling tools, and email platforms.

- Attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.

- Ability to work well in a team environment and manage multiple tasks effectively.

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops)



People Contacts and Interactions

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment)

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes)

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions)

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment



Role Requirements

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred)

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent)

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents)

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back

title: TikTok Operator (Shop & Account)
description:
[Read properly before applying]

[Do not apply if you do not meet the requirements or you do not possess the ample experience]

[This is NOT a VIDEO EDITOR job opening]

[This is NOT a CONTENT CREATOR job opening]

---



We're hiring a TikTok Operator to run and grow our U.S. TikTok Shop. This isn't a content or social media job — it's a business role. You'll own the whole channel: TikTok Shop, creators/affiliates, content, ads, livestreams, and the numbers behind all of it.



We want a builder! Someone who either launched a TikTok Shop from zero and made it succeed, or took over a shop that wasn't performing and turned it around. It needs to be *their* win — not a channel they just helped run while someone else called the shots.



You'll start hands-on, with room to build and lead a team as the channel grows.





JOB SPECIFICATIONS



[TikTok Business & Profitability]

- Understands how to grow TikTok sales while protecting margin, not just chasing GMV

- Good with numbers — can tell what's working, what's not, and what to scale or stop



[TikTok Shop Operations]

- Knows how TikTok Shop works — listings, pricing, promos, bundles, discount codes, store health



[Creators & Affiliates]

- Experience finding, recruiting, and managing TikTok creators and affiliates



[Content, Advertising & Livestream]

- Can guide short-form content strategy based on what performs well

- Familiar with TikTok Ads/Spark Ads and livestream operations



[Analytics & Reporting]

- Comfortable pulling together weekly performance updates and explaining the "why" behind the numbers



[Systems & Team Building]

- Can build simple SOPs/processes so the work runs smoothly as the team grows

- Open to eventually helping hire and manage a small supporting team





DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run the TikTok channel and grow its sales for the U.S. market

- Manage the TikTok Shop — product listings, pricing, promos, and store health

- Find, recruit, and manage TikTok creators and affiliates to promote products

- Plan and guide short-form video content based on what performs well

- Handle or oversee TikTok ads and livestreams

- Give weekly updates on sales, ads, creators, and content performance

- Create simple processes so the work can run smoothly as the team grows

- Strong English communication skills, written and verbal

- Can work independently, solve problems, and take full ownership of results





NON-NEGOTIABLES



- Based within Luzon, and willing to travel to NCR whenever the CEO is in Manila to check in with the team

- Was the main driver — not just a helper — behind a TikTok Shop's growth or launch. This means one of:

 [1] Launched a TikTok Shop from scratch and built it into a success (or at least got it to a strong state before leaving the company/client), or...

 [2] Took over a TikTok Shop with little to no traction (low sales/GMV) and turned it around

- Can clearly explain *their own* strategy and decisions behind that growth — not just point to results the shop achieved under someone else's plan

- Strong track record of driving measurable sales growth and improving overall TikTok channel performance

- Strong understanding of the TikTok Shop ecosystem and its key sales/growth drivers





NICE TO HAVE



- Background in health, wellness, beauty, personal care, supplements, medical products, sports, or other regulated consumer categories

- Experience managing TikTok at significant sales/GMV scale, or across multiple brands/shops

- Experience building or leading a TikTok/e-commerce team, or managing large creator networks

- Direct experience working with TikTok account managers or platform reps

- Experience managing TikTok alongside Amazon or other major e-commerce channels

Remote | Full-time | Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM Philippine Time



Who we are



Babiesmart is one of the fastest-growing names in Australia's baby and maternity space. We're the brand house behind Toddly, BabiePlay, Feather & Fawn and Glowly, making practical, thoughtfully designed products that parents trust.



We're a small team, so everyone here matters, and everyone's work shows up in the results.



Why this role is different



You don't need to be an expert yet. We train you properly on our brands, our tools and how we work, and give you paid access to professional AI tools (Google AI Ultra and ChatGPT Plus).



Real growth, not just a job. We train you, give you more responsibility as you're ready, and review your pay every year to match. 



One team, clear communication. Fixed hours with a 1-hour break, real ownership, and a performance review at 6 months. We value people who communicate openly, support each other, and take responsibility. Those who do grow with us.

What you'll do

title: SENIOR DTC PRODUCT RESEARCH, DEVELOPMENT & FULFILLMENT SPECIALIST
description:
Daggo Group LLC is building a portfolio of international Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) brands, beginning with the United States.



We are looking for an experienced DTC operator who has already worked behind the scenes with successful e-commerce brands.



This is NOT an entry-level research position.



We do not want someone we need to train on how DTC works.



We are looking for someone who already understands how to move from:



Market → Customer → Problem → Product Opportunity → Validation → Economics → Supplier → Fulfillment → Launch



WHAT WE NEED



You should be able to receive a market or business objective and independently:



• Research the market and customer.



• Identify high-value customer problems and opportunities.



• Conduct Voice of Customer research.



• Analyze existing products, competitors and customer complaints.



• Identify and evaluate potential product solutions.



• Validate product opportunities before significant capital is committed.



• Understand DTC unit economics, including COGS, AOV, CAC, contribution margin, returns and inventory requirements.



• Research and evaluate manufacturers and suppliers.



• Understand product development, sampling, MOQ, quality control and landed cost.



• Understand US fulfillment and 3PL requirements.



• Identify operational risks before launch.



• Build clear recommendations based on evidence.



• Tell us when an opportunity should be CONTINUED, MODIFIED or KILLED.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We strongly prefer candidates who have previously worked directly with DTC/e-commerce brands in areas such as:



• Product research and development

• E-commerce operations

• Market and customer research

• Product sourcing

• Supplier management

• Inventory planning

• Fulfillment / 3PL

• Product launches

• DTC unit economics



We are NOT primarily looking for:



• General virtual assistants

• Entry-level product researchers

• Dropshipping “winning product” hunters

• Shopify designers

• People whose experience is mainly theoretical



You should already know the tools, research methods and information sources required to do this work.



We care more about the QUALITY and SPEED of your execution than the number of hours you work.



This is a deliverables-driven engagement, not a 40-hour-per-week research job.



COMPENSATION



We are prepared to pay above typical market rates for exceptional candidates.



Target compensation is approximately $2,500 USD/month equivalent, depending on experience, capability and engagement structure.



We are also open to project-based compensation for the initial engagement.



INITIAL ENGAGEMENT



The successful candidate will first be engaged on a paid project/contract.



You will work on a real DTC opportunity from our current pipeline.



We will evaluate:



• Quality of thinking

• Research depth

• Commercial judgment

• Speed of execution

• Independence

• Product-development knowledge

• Supplier and fulfillment knowledge

• Communication and responsiveness

• Ability to identify risks

• Ability to make decisions without constant Founder input



Exceptional performance can lead to an ongoing long-term engagement with Daggo Group LLC.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with:



“DTC OPERATOR”



Then answer the following:



1. Which DTC/e-commerce brands have you worked with? State your exact role and responsibilities.



2. Describe one product you helped take from research/opportunity identification through development or launch.



3. What part of the process did YOU personally own?



4. Describe one product or market opportunity you recommended NOT pursuing and why.



5. Describe your experience working with manufacturers, suppliers, samples, MOQ, landed costs and quality control.



6. Describe your experience with US fulfillment, 3PLs, inventory and returns.



7. Give an example where your research or operational decision directly improved revenue, margin, conversion, inventory efficiency or another measurable business outcome.



8. Which tools do you personally use for market research, competitive intelligence, sourcing and DTC analysis?



9. What is your current availability and how quickly can you complete a typical market/product opportunity assessment?



10. What compensation structure do you prefer: project-based, monthly retainer or another arrangement?



Please include evidence, portfolio examples or references where possible.



AI tools are welcome, but we are hiring your EXPERIENCE, JUDGMENT and EXECUTION — not your ability to generate a research report with AI.

description:

JOB SUMMARY:

As our Amazon Brand Manager, you'll be the one steering how our products perform on Amazon day to day — from pricing and promotions to ad campaigns and everything in between. You'll keep an eye on our listings, spot opportunities to grow revenue, and help us stay ahead in our category.





RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Manage daily sales operations for assigned products, including pricing, promotions, and advertising campaigns

- Oversee product listings and identify new revenue opportunities within respective categories

- Monitor product performance to drive consistent sales growth and stronger category rankings

- Conduct in-depth product analysis and research market trends/competitors to guide strategic decisions

- Collaborate with the inventory planning team to manage promotions and excess inventory

- Ensure accuracy, timeliness, and confidentiality across all deliverables





QUALIFICATIONS:

• Strong brand management experience — from listing optimization and A+ Content to product launches and brand positioning

• PPC experience is a plus, but not required

• Strong analytical, data-driven decision-making skills

• Solid market research experience

• Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)

• Strong documentation and time management skills





NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS:

• This role is strictly for applicants based within NCR or nearby areas (e.g., Bulacan, Rizal).

• You'll need to send a portfolio with a real ASIN you've personally handled from launch to finish (brand/product can be blurred), backed by substantial data — think sales or bestseller ranking graphs, not just a screenshot. If NDA-restricted or you no longer have account access, a short video walkthrough explaining the work and results is acceptable instead.

• Be ready to walk through and explain the actual performance data behind that ASIN during the interview — conversion rate, ACOS, organic vs. paid sales split. This will be a substantial part of the conversation, so come prepared to speak to real numbers, not general claims.





SETUP:

• Full-time, 9AM to 6PM PHT

• Uses Time Doctor for time tracking

• Own equipment needed (Laptop, Mouse, Earphones/Headphones)

• Stable internet connection, with a readily available backup connection

• Full-time contractual employment (renewal contract based on performance)

• There will be quarterly (with chances of it being monthly) meet-ups within NCR whenever the CEO visits the Philippines

title: Marketing assistant – CRM and lead generation (full-time, remote)
description:
Type BrandingGCC as the first line of your application. We will not read applications without it.



We are a branding consultancy based in Dubai and London. We work with large brands across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Kuwait. We are hiring one person to rebuild our contact database and run our outreach programme.



This is a long-term role for someone who works independently and wants to grow with a small team.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Month one is split evenly between two jobs.



The first half of your time, on our existing data:

- Import our existing contact spreadsheet into Pipedrive

- Verify every imported record, since the data is three years old

- Check each contact on LinkedIn first, then the company website, then a web search

- Once records are verified, send our white paper link to them using Kit



The second half of your time, on new prospects:

- Research marketing directors and CMOs at companies on our target list

- Find and verify their work
 addresses

- Send up to 20 connection invites a day from our founder's LinkedIn account



From month two onward:

- New prospect research becomes the main job

- Keep Pipedrive accurate and current

- Report weekly on records verified, contacts added, invites sent and acceptances



From month three:

- Send our quarterly newsletter using Kit, from content we supply

- Manage the white paper download that captures new contacts



The invites take under an hour a day. The rest of your time is research, verification and CRM work. You will plan that yourself.



WHAT WE NEED



- Three years in lead generation or marketing operations, or two with strong evidence

- Excellent written English, correct spelling and grammar

- Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator

- Experience with LinkedIn Helper or a similar tool

- Experience with Pipedrive, HubSpot or a similar CRM

- Experience with Kit, Mailchimp or a similar
 tool

- Accurate and methodical, since verification matters more than volume

- Able to plan your own day and hit weekly targets

- Reliable internet, a backup connection and your own computer

- Two contactable references from previous employers



USEFUL BUT NOT ESSENTIAL



-
 finding tools such as Hunter or Apollo

- Any experience with Middle East or GCC markets



HOURS



9am to 6pm Manila time, Monday to Friday. We have a 15-minute call each day at 3pm your time, which is 11am in Dubai. It is a quick catch-up on how things are going and what is coming next. We work as a small team and want you in the conversation.



HOW WE SEND



Our clients are in the Gulf, so timing matters. Nothing goes out at their breakfast time or on their weekend.



- Schedule every send. Never send to a Gulf inbox at your 9am, since that is 5am in Dubai

- Aim for 8am to 11am in the client's own time zone

- Default to Tuesday and Wednesday, which work across all four markets

- Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Kuwait work Sunday to Thursday. The UAE works Monday to Friday



PAY AND TERMS



- 800 USD per month, full-time

- 30 USD for every credentials meeting that goes ahead, up to four a month

- 300 USD when we sign a project with a client you sourced

- Paid on the 15th and 30th via Wise, fees covered by us

- Three-month trial at full pay, with two weeks' notice on either side

- A review at three months, with a rise to 950 USD for the right person and 30 days' notice thereafter

- Thirteenth month bonus in December, pro-rated by months worked

- Paid Philippine public holidays



A sourced client is one you researched and added to our database, with no prior relationship with us. Meetings count when they are with a marketing director or above at a company on our target list.



We want one person fully committed to us, working full-time. This is not a role for someone juggling several clients.



HOW WE RUN OUR ACCOUNTS



Pipedrive, Kit and your research all run from your own computer as normal. LinkedIn is the exception. For account security we may ask you to run LinkedIn Helper through a remote desktop connected to our Dubai office.



All software accounts are owned and paid for by us. We hold the master logins and share access with you through a password manager. Everything you build stays with the company. This is standard for the role and we will walk you through it on day one.



HOW TO APPLY



Type BrandingGCC as the first line of your application.



Tell us about your experience, the CRM tools you have used and your notice period. List your roles from the past three years with start and end dates.



Then answer these four questions:



1. A company's LinkedIn page uses a different name to its trading name. How would you find its marketing director?

2. You need the work
 of a marketing director at a GCC company. Their LinkedIn shows only a Gmail address. What steps would you take?

3. How would you import a spreadsheet of 500 contacts into a CRM without creating duplicates?

4. What would you do if you could not verify a contact's job title with certainty?



We will ignore any application without the word BrandingGCC or the four answers.

title: Virtual Training Coach
description:
Hi,



I'm looking for someone to become my virtual training partner AND fitness coach on an ongoing basis.



This is a little different from a normal online personal training role.



I'm looking for someone who wants to share the journey - I will be motivated by not just being told what to do but hearing about your journey too.



I would like someone that is looking to train regularly themselves, share progress with each other and for you to motivate me.



I'd like someone who is:

* Positive, fun and engaging

* Reliable with daily communication

* Comfortable sending voice notes, pictures and videos

* Comfortable receiving workout pictures/videos from me

* Happy having regular video calls

* Willing to challenge me

* Able to have some banter

* Interested in actually getting to know the person they're coaching



What the job entails:

* Initial assessment of current position

* Creation of workout plan and diet goals

* Set timings for check ins and daily communication

* Track progress by preferred method

* Tweak plans where necessary

* Create engaging content to keep motivation



I'd expect communication most days, although it can be very quick messages whenever suits. 



Some days it could simply be:



**“Gym done ? Here's today's session.”**



Other days we might have a longer conversation about training, food, motivation or progress.







You don't necessarily need to be a qualified personal trainer. You could be a:

* Personal trainer

* Fitness coach

* Sports science student/graduate

* Gym enthusiast

* Someone who simply loves training and takes their fitness seriously



Being actively involved in your own fitness journey is essential.



Pay:

Initial budget is around $100–$150 USD per month, depending on experience and how involved you would like to be.



If we work well together, I'd like this to become a long-term arrangement.



## How to apply



Please send me:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your current fitness/training goals

3. Your expected monthly rate

4. Experience of this type of work if possible

5. A recent fitness/workout photo if you're comfortable sharing one

6. A 30–60 second video introducing yourself



Please start your application with the words:



**TRAINING PARTNER**



I'm looking for someone I'll enjoy speaking to and who genuinely wants to get fitter, stronger and healthier alongside me.



Thanks,

Aaron

title: Senior Short-Form UGC Video Editor
description:
Please read the full post before applying.



ABOUT ME

I'm a UGC creator producing short-form video content. I post 5 videos every day across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Snapchat Spotlight, and
 Reels. I shoot the footage, write the briefs, and handle the brand relationship. I need ONE elite editor to turn my raw footage into polished, high-retention videos, every day, on time, exactly to brief.

This is a long-term, full-time role with guaranteed daily volume, 7 days per week. If you're great, you'll have steady work, a raise path, and bonuses tied to performance.



WHO THIS IS FOR

- You've edited hundreds of short-form vertical videos, and some of them have performed. You know why they performed.

- You treat a brief as a spec, not a suggestion. If the brief says the hook text is white, 6 words, on screen at 0:00, then it is white, 6 words, on screen at 0:00.

- You catch your own mistakes before I do. Typos, audio pops, captions out of sync, text in the platform's UI safe zone. These never reach me.

- You reply fast, you hit deadlines without being reminded, and if something goes wrong, I hear it from you first, before the deadline, with a solution.

- You can work through a full shift without asking questions. You read the brief, check the reference videos, and make smart calls on your own. 

- You want this to be your main client. Small side projects are fine as long as they never affect my deadlines or response times. 



WHO THIS IS NOT FOR

- Editors who need hand-holding or multiple revision rounds to get a brief right

- Template-only editors who apply the same caption preset to everything

- Anyone juggling several other full-time clients



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Edit 5 short-form vertical videos (15–90 seconds) per day from my raw footage and written briefs

- Build strong hooks: pacing, punch-ins, pattern interrupts, on-screen text in the first 1–2 seconds

- Write and style captions and kinetic text that are 100% accurate and on-brand

- Sound design: music selection and timing, SFX, audio cleanup, consistent levels

- Include any brand-required elements exactly as specified in the brief

- A computer that handles 4K footage without lag

- Clear written English. Most of our communication is written.

- Responds quickly and submits on time

- Backup power and internet are preferred, but not necessary



RELIABILITY AND COMMUNICATION STANDARDS

DAILY SCHEDULE (all times Philippine Time)

10:00 AM – Footage, audio, and briefs are in the shared folder. Your shift starts.

10:00 AM to 6:00 PM (or until whenever you’re done with all videos for the day) – Edit all of the day's videos. Work independently; I'm offline.

6:00 PM – Hard deadline. All videos delivered, with any questions or judgment calls noted.

9:00 PM – I send revision notes, if any.

9:00 PM to 10:00 PM – Revisions completed and re-delivered.

- During the initial few hours of working hours: reply to messages within 15 minutes

- Daily check-in message at the start and end of your shift: what's done, what's in progress, any blockers

- If you will miss a deadline for ANY reason, tell me as soon as you know, not after

- Tools: 
 for communication, Google Drive for footage and delivery, Google Drive comments for revisions

- You will work independently. I upload footage and briefs, then I'm offline for the night. Don't expect real-time guidance.

- If something in a brief is unclear, make the best call based on the brief, your past experience, and my past videos, then note your decision when you deliver. If it's a genuine toss-up, deliver both versions.

- Batch any questions and send them with your delivery. I'll answer in the morning.

- Only message me during your shift if something will cause a missed deadline (footage corrupted, files missing, etc.)

- To confirm you’ve read this section, include the word safezone in your answer to Q3



PAY

- $3-5 USD/video (est. $
USD/month) 

- Performance bonuses per video: $5 at 50k views, $15 at 100k views, $40 at 250k views, $75 at 500k views, $150 at 1M views, $500 at 5M+ views (views counted 14 days after posting)

- $40 monthly bonus for zero missed deadlines

- $20 monthly bonus for zero revisions caused by editor errors

-Bonuses are uncapped, so one viral video can add a significant amount to your month. 



HOW TO APPLY

 Subject line must be: UGC EDITOR – [Your Full Name] – [Approximate number of short-form videos you've edited]

In your application, include:

1. Three LIVE links to short-form vertical videos you edited. At least one should be a product, app, or tech ad. For each, write one sentence on what YOU specifically did (editing only? captions? sound? hook concept?) and how it performed if you know.

2. A 60–90 second voice note or video (Loom, Google Drive, etc.) introducing yourself and explaining your editing process. No script reading.

3. Short, specific answers to these questions in your own words. Short and sharp beats long and generic. AI-written answers are easy to spot and will be rejected.

 Q1. Walk me through exactly what you do in the first 3 seconds of a UGC ad, and why.

 Q2. My brief asks for something you're confident will perform worse than your idea. What do you do?

 Q6. Attach a screenshot of a speed test from your main internet (and a picture of your backup power/internet if you have it, but not necessary).

4. Your current client load and how many hours per week you're truly available.



HIRING PROCESS

1. Application review

2. Paid test edit: shortlisted editors get real raw footage plus a real brief, with a 24-hour window. Paid $5. Graded on brief adherence first, quality second, speed third.

3. 1-week paid trial at full workload

4. Long-term commitment/contract



If you are the kind of editor who takes pride in delivering exactly what was asked, on time, every time, I want to work with you. I look forward to your application.

title: Amazon Advertising Specialist | 32h per week | PHP 70k - 85k per Month | Medior - Senior
description:
Amazon Advertising Specialist



Remote, Philippines

Mid level to senior

PHP 70k - 85k per Month



---



Advertising should help a brand generate more revenue, protect its margin and keep control of growth.



That takes more than adjusting bids. You need to understand how campaign structure, organic visibility, conversion and product priorities influence each other.



Brightways is a Dutch marketplace specialist. We manage Amazon growth for established brands across Europe and other international markets. Germany and the United Kingdom are two of our main markets.



We are looking for an experienced Amazon Advertising Specialist based in the Philippines. You will work remotely with our advertising team and Marketplace Managers in the Netherlands.



---



You take responsibility for advertising performance



You will manage Amazon Ads accounts for several international brands.



Some accounts need a stronger campaign structure. Others need better budget allocation or more control over profit. You analyse the situation, d
 what needs attention and turn that decision into action.



Your work includes:

- Creating and managing Amazon Ads campaigns

- Managing Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display

- Building campaign structures around products, markets and commercial goals

- Researching search terms, keywords, categories and product targets

- Setting and adjusting budgets and bids

- Reviewing branded and non branded performance

- Dividing spend across products, campaigns and marketplaces

- Analysing ACoS, TACoS, CVR, sales and margin

- Finding wasted spend and missed growth opportunities

- Preparing clear performance updates

- Recommending and carrying out improvements

- Explaining your decisions to Marketplace Managers and clients



Amazon is the main focus. Experience with Bol Ads is useful, but not required.



-- 



You understand what the numbers mean



A lower ACoS is not always a better result. More advertising sales do not automatically create more profit.



You look at what advertising contributes to the wider marketplace business. That includes sales, margin, organic visibility and product growth.



You can recognise when a campaign needs more budget. You also know when advertising spend should move to a different product or marketplace.



--



You can manage accounts independently



This role suits someone who already has solid experience with Amazon Ads.



You have managed advertising accounts independently and understand the decisions behind campaign performance. You can explain what you changed, why you changed it and what the result was.



We expect you to:

- Understand Amazon Ads campaign structures and targeting options

- Work confidently with advertising and sales data

- Manage several accounts without losing control of priorities

- Recognise patterns and unusual results

- Turn an analysis into a clear next step

- Test ideas and review their effect

- Communicate clearly in English

- Take responsibility for the accuracy of your work

- Raise problems early instead of waiting for instructions

- Explain your recommendations in a practical way



You do not need experience in every Amazon marketplace. You do need enough Amazon Ads experience to make sound decisions without daily guidance.



Experience with Excel, Google Sheets and advertising automation tools is helpful.



--



Technology and AI supports your judgment



Automation is already part of how we manage advertising at Brightways.



We use technology for campaign management, analysis and reporting. That gives you more time to focus on decisions that require commercial judgment.



You should understand what the tools are doing. When the output does not make sense, you investigate and intervene.



We also use AI to improve analyses, reporting and internal processes. You do not need a technical background, but we expect you to explore new ways of working and share what works with the team.



--



You work as part of a specialist team



You will work remotely from the Philippines with colleagues in the Netherlands.



Marketplace Managers set the wider direction for each client. You bring the advertising expertise. You will also work with specialists in content, design, operations and data.



That wider context matters. Advertising performs better when the listing converts, the product holds the Buy Box and stock is available.



Communication is open and direct. If a strategy is not working, you say so. If you see an opportunity, you explain it and take the next step.



--



What you can expect from Brightways



You will work across different brands, product categories and international Amazon marketplaces.



You will get clear responsibilities, regular contact with the team and room to improve how we work. As your knowledge and ownership grow, your role can grow with them.



The exact working hours and compensation depend on your experience and availability. We will discuss these openly during the application process.



--



Apply without a long process



Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short introduction.



Tell us which Amazon Ads accounts you have managed and what level of responsibility you had. You can also share one campaign decision that made a clear difference.



A short introduction video is MANDATORY. Do start your video with "Hi team Brightways".



We review relevant applications personally.

title: LONG-FORM VIDEO EDITOR – Video Podcast (Archival Photos + Broadcast Delivery)
description:
We're producing an 8-episode video podcast. Each episode must pass a technical and standards review needs for Canadian broadcast and airs on a Canadian TV platform and YouTube. 





WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build each 30–35 minute episode from a 2 camera shoot

- Integrate archival photos, documents and newspaper clippings with motion and intercutting

- Clean, balance and mix dialogue to broadcast loudness

- Basic colour correction and broadcast-legal video levels

- Build and maintain the series template: opening card, lower thirds, closing credit card, all title-safe

- Export and name files to spec, then run a QC pass before handoff

- Keep an archival-use log per episode: asset ID, timecode in/out, on-screen duration, and total time of anything marked "outside region"

- Export 3 still-frame options per episode for artwork (1600x900, no text)

- Make revisions from the host, then from the broadcaster's review notes

REQUIREMENTS

- 1+ years editing long-form (20+ min) multicam interview, podcast or documentary content

- DaVinci Resolve (preferred) or Premiere Pro (or equivalent programs)

- Real audio skills: you measure integrated loudness and true peak

- Taste with archival material: photo moves, documents, clippings, object inserts

- Clear written English for timecoded notes and logs

- Internet that can download 50–100 GB per episode, and a machine that handles multicam

- First cut within 5 days of receiving footage



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the words "THE TABLE". Then answer:

1. Link one long-form (20+ min) multicam conversation or documentary you edited. What exactly did you do on it?

2. What loudness target and true peak limit do you mix dialogue to for TV, and what tool do you measure it with?

3. Describe three ways you'd make an old still photograph feel alive on screen without it feeling like a slideshow.

4. Your weekly availability, preferred rate and your turnaround for a first cut of a 35-minute episode.

title: AI Video Editor / AI Filmmaker for DTC E-commerce Brand
description:
We are a growing DTC e-commerce company looking for a **full-time Video Editor with strong AI video generation skills**.



AI content creation is the priority. You should be able to create high-quality AI footage across different styles, then turn that footage into polished, fast-paced ads.



What You'll Create



We produce AI video in styles including:



- **Ultra-realistic:** footage that is extremely difficult to distinguish from real video

- **Claymation**

- **Pixar-style / high-end 3D animation**

- **3D medical, anatomical, X-ray and skeleton visuals**

- **AI-generated B-roll**

- Other creative AI visual styles as concepts require



We have one important rule:



AI should either look extremely realistic OR deliberately stylized and clearly artificial.



We do **not** want the uncanny middle ground where footage is supposed to look real but obviously looks AI-generated.



What We Need From You



You should be able to:



- Generate high-quality AI video and images

- Work with the latest AI models and quickly learn new ones

- Follow detailed creative briefs accurately

- Turn around work quickly and reliably

- Create multiple variations from your own work

- Iterate quickly when we find a concept, visual or ad that performs

- Work independently and suggest better creative solutions when appropriate

- Edit complete advertisements when needed



Our target production volume is approximately **5–7 videos per week**, including variations of existing videos.



Editing Skills



AI generation is the priority, but you should also be comfortable with:



- Cutting and assembling ads

- Strong pacing

- Animated captions

- Basic motion graphics

- Minor VFX

- Sound effects and sound design

- Music

- Transitions

- Colour correction/grading

- Stabilisation and footage cleanup



Premiere Pro and After Effects experience is preferred, especially because we need complete editable working files.



AI Tools



You should be comfortable working across the current generation of leading AI tools rather than depending on only one platform.



Our current workflow includes tools such as:



- Higgsfield

- Seedance

- Nano Banana

- ChatGPT

- Claude

- ElevenLabs



Experience with other leading video/image generation models such as Kling, Veo, Runway, Sora, ComfyUI or similar tools is a plus.



We can provide required subscriptions when necessary, but **we prefer someone who already has an established AI production workflow and their own tools/subscriptions.**



The same applies to stock footage, music and asset subscriptions.



File Delivery



We care strongly about organised, reusable source material.



For completed work, you may be required to provide:



- Final export **with music and captions**

- Final export **without music and captions**

- Clean AI-generated footage

- Clean source footage/selects, trimmed, stabilised, colour-graded and ready for reuse

- Premiere/After Effects or other project files

- All project assets

- Prompts and generation settings

- Source/reference images

- Music and SFX files

- Editable captions



Your work should be organised so another editor can easily open the project and continue working from it.



Who We're Looking For



You do not need to have 10 years of experience.



We care more about someone who is:



- Hard-working

- Fast

- Reliable

- Available full-time

- Detail-oriented

- Good at following instructions

- Able to learn new AI tools very quickly

- Comfortable receiving feedback

- Able to create variations quickly

- Interested in continuously improving their AI generation skills



Strong previous experience is preferred, but a highly capable intermediate editor who learns extremely quickly is also welcome.



There is **no requirement to work Netherlands/European hours**. You can work according to your normal schedule as long as communication and delivery are reliable.



Application



Start your application with the word: SWEET!



Then answer these questions:



1. How long have you been working with AI video generation?

2. Which AI video and image-generation tools do you currently use?

3. Which AI/software subscriptions do you personally already have?

4. Which editing software do you use?

5. Which stock footage, music or asset subscriptions do you have?

6. Can you provide complete editable project files and source assets?

7. How many videos could you realistically produce per working day?

8. Send your **best examples of photorealistic AI video**.

9. Send your **best examples of stylized/animated AI video**.

10. Send examples of **medical/anatomical/3D AI visuals**, if available.

11. Send examples of your normal video editing work.

12. Tell us briefly about one AI video you created: which tools did you use and what parts did you personally create?



Please send **specific examples of your own work**, not a large generic portfolio.



Shortlisted applicants will first complete a **small test**, followed by a paid full assignment if successful.



This is a full-time position with the potential for long-term work.

title: Interior Design Consultant
description:
Snug Nest Designs, is an Interior Design Studio based out of Melbourne Australia. We are committed to enhancing quality of life through the power of exceptional design. We believe that any space is a true reflection of the owner's personality and lifestyle.



We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and proactive Interior Design Consultant with strong residential design experience. The ideal candidate is confident across concept development, space planning, 3D visualisation, FF&E sourcing, documentation, and project coordination. You should be organised, a strong communicator, comfortable working independently and as part of a team, and eager to use technology and AI to improve design workflows and efficiency.

3. Design Development: Develop concepts into detailed designs, including custom joinery, feature walls, built-ins, and bespoke design elements.

4. 3D Modelling & Visualisation: Create accurate 3D models and realistic, presentation-ready visuals that effectively communicate the design intent.

HOW THE WORK GETS DONE



Most of the day-to-day campaign work here runs through Claude Code, an AI tool that works in a command line (terminal). We use it to build campaigns, run audits, make changes, and produce reports. You do not have to be a developer. You do have to be comfortable typing into a terminal, following a written playbook step by step, reading what the tool returns, and checking it against the live Google Ads account before anything goes live. We provide the playbooks. You bring the Google Ads judgment.

- Own Google Search campaigns from setup through ongoing optimization

- Handle keywords, negative lists, bids, budgets, and ad copy

- Dig into performance data, find wasted spend, and fix it

- Grow budgets step by step once results justify it

- Log every change you make and the reason behind it



WHAT YOU BRING



- Hands-on Google Ads experience on real accounts. Courses and certificates alone are not enough.

- A track record of growing campaigns from a modest budget to a much larger monthly spend without results falling apart

- Solid Search fundamentals: match types, negative keywords, Quality Score, conversion tracking, and bidding strategies, and knowing when each one fits

TO APPLY (WE SCREEN ON THESE STEPS)

2. Answer these three questions, in this order:

   a) Which companies or accounts have you managed Google Ads for? For each one, give the approximate monthly ad spend and the results you achieved.

Strong applications hear back fast. Generic or copy-paste applications will not get a reply.
