title: Video Editor & Content Partner (First Hire, Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
TITLE

Full-Time Video Editor and Content Partner (First Hire at Mattering, Long-Term, One Client Only)



SALARY

USD 1,100 base plus USD 100 health stipend (approx. PHP 60,000 to 70,000 per month to start), paid in USD, with 13th month pay, paid leave, and a six-month raise review. Details below.



JOB TYPE

Full-time, long-term, dedicated. You work for Mattering and only Mattering.



-----------------------------------------------------------



THE SHORT VERSION



Mattering is an AI workspace platform, a suite of business apps built around chat and agents. Until now it has been built and run by one person. Me. The product is live. The company has never had a second person in it.



This role is that second person.



-----------------------------------------------------------



WHAT THIS ACTUALLY IS



You would be the first hire Mattering has ever made. Not the first content hire. The first anybody. There is no team to join, no manager between us, and nobody ahead of you. Every person who joins after you comes in behind you.



The job itself is content. You d
 what Mattering sounds like on YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and LinkedIn, and then you make it. You will have full access to the product, to the problems our customers are trying to solve, and to how I think about the business, because there is no version of this where you don't.



I will be honest about where we are. This is early. The content engine does not exist yet. The company is me, a working product, and the person reading this. If you want a defined role at a settled company, this is not it. If you want to be the person who was there when it was two people, keep reading.



-----------------------------------------------------------



THE CREATIVE BRIEF



Funny on the outside, useful on the inside.



Mattering competes with big, well-funded names in the AI and productivity space. We will not out-spend them. We can out-entertain them and out-teach them. The content has to be enjoyable enough that people actually watch it, and credible enough that a business owner trusts us with their work. Finding that line every week is the job.



Formats you will own:

- Short-form video (TikTok, Reels, Shorts): hooks, pacing, captions, sound

- Long-form YouTube: product walkthroughs, founder-led storytelling, tutorials

- Clipping and repurposing: turning recordings, demos and screen captures into a steady stream of short content

- Thumbnails and titles

- A publishing calendar you run, not one you are handed



-----------------------------------------------------------



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Edit and package video content daily, short-form and long-form

- Turn raw founder footage, screen recordings and product demos into finished pieces without waiting to be told how

- Write hooks, titles, captions and descriptions

- Design thumbnails and simple motion graphics

- Build and run the content calendar across channels

- Track what performs, tell me why, and change the plan based on it

- Learn the product deeply enough to explain it better than I do

- Over time, define the Mattering content voice and own it



-----------------------------------------------------------



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



Required:

- 3+ years editing video professionally, with a portfolio that shows both short-form and long-form work

- Strong in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, comfortable in CapCut for fast short-form

- You understand retention, hooks and pacing, not just cuts and transitions

- You can make something funny without making it stupid

- Fluent written and spoken English

- Reliable internet, a machine that can handle 4K timelines, and a quiet place to work

- At least 3 hours of daily overlap with US Pacific time (this is your morning)

- You want one long-term employer, not a roster of clients



Strong plus:

- After Effects or motion graphics

- Thumbnail design (Photoshop, Figma or similar)

- Experience with SaaS, software or tech content

- You have grown a channel or account yourself, even a small one

- You have used AI tools in your editing workflow and have opinions about them



-----------------------------------------------------------



WHO THIS IS FOR, AND WHO IT IS NOT FOR



This is for you if you are tired of being handed a brief and want to be the person who writes it. If you have ideas you never got to make because the client said no. If you would rather build a channel from zero and have it be yours than inherit one.



This is not for you if you want clear instructions for every task, if you need a large team around you, or if you are looking for a side project alongside other clients.



-----------------------------------------------------------



COMPENSATION AND COMMITMENT



What you get:

- Fixed monthly retainer, paid in USD on the same date every month, starting at USD 1,100

- USD 100 per month health and benefits stipend on top of base

- 13th month pay, paid every December

- 12 days paid leave per year plus Philippine regular holidays

- Six-month review with a raise target of USD 1,300 to 1,500 based on performance

- Annual review after that

- One month written notice, both directions

- Direct daily access to the founder and the full product



What I ask in return:

- Full-time, dedicated. No other clients during the engagement.

- Ownership. You bring the plan, I do not chase you for it.

- Honesty. If something is not working, I want to hear it from you first.



This is a long-term independent contractor engagement, not a short-term gig. The first 30 days are a paid trial at full rate with a clear scorecard. After that we sign the long-term agreement.



-----------------------------------------------------------



THE HONEST PART ABOUT GROWTH



I cannot promise you Mattering becomes a big company. I can promise that if it does, you were first, the content side is yours to lead, and the next content hire reports to you. Growth here is real but it is earned, by both of us.



Someone is going to be the first person at Mattering. I would rather it be someone who knows exactly what that means.



-----------------------------------------------------------



HOW TO APPLY



Read this carefully. Applications that skip a step will not be reviewed. This is the first test.



1. Put the words PERSON TWO at the start of your subject line.

2. Link your portfolio. Include at least two short-form pieces and one long-form piece. Tell me which parts of each you personally did.

3. Record a 2 to 3 minute Loom or video. Not a script, just you talking. Tell me about one video you made better without being asked to, and what you changed.

4. Answer this in 3 to 5 sentences: Mattering sells software to business owners. How do you make that funny without making the product look like a joke?

5. Tell me your expected monthly salary in PHP and when you could start.



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to do a paid spec edit from real footage before interviews. You will be paid for it whether or not you are hired.



-----------------------------------------------------------



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



- Shortlist of 10 reviewed by me personally

- Paid spec edit sent to 5

- Video interviews with 3

- One offer, with a 30-day paid trial, then the long-term agreement



I read every application that follows the steps. If you are the right person, you will hear from me quickly.

This role focuses on coordinating and executing campaigns using proven strategy, repurposed assets and established workflows. You’ll work alongside the Growth Director to ensure strategy translates into well-executed campaigns.

title: Quality and Compliance Coordinator
description:
Quality and Compliance Coordinator



Work Arrangement: Full-time, Remote

Location: Philippines

Schedule: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM AEST

Employment Type: Full-time



About the Role



We are looking for a Quality and Compliance Coordinator to join an Australian-based company operating within a regulated product environment.



This is a hands-on role with a strong focus on quality, compliance, documentation, and process improvement. The successful candidate will play an important role in building and maintaining the company's Quality Management System (QMS), managing quality i
 and corrective actions, maintaining product and regulatory compliance, and developing clear, controlled processes across the business.



This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a solid foundation in quality and compliance who enjoys building systems from the ground up and taking ownership of processes.



You will not be expected to have a fully developed QMS on day one. The company will provide training and direction as you progressively build the quality framework and develop your capability within the role.



Approximately 70% of the role will focus on Quality and Compliance, while approximately 30% will involve cross-training and providing operational backup across areas such as customer service, purchasing, accounting support, and logistics.



Key Responsibilities

Quality and Compliance



Quality I
 Management



Own the Quality I
 database by logging, investigating, tracking, and closing out i
.

Coordinate corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) with relevant stakeholders.

Verify the effectiveness of corrective actions.

Report quality i
 trends to management.



Quality Management System (QMS)



Build and develop the QMS from the ground up.

Develop the quality policy and quality manual structure.

Establish and maintain the documentation framework.

Maintain controlled document registers and version control.

Conduct internal reviews and support external audit preparation.



Product and Regulatory Compliance



Maintain product and regulatory compliance records.

Support regulatory registration, chemical categorisation, verification, and record-keeping requirements.

Maintain product compliance databases and records.

Manage SDS/TDS documentation, COA review and issuance, and related compliance documentation.

Support dangerous goods/hazardous classification, product labelling, and compliance forms.

Manage product release/hold procedures, batch traceability, and recall procedures.

Respond to customer quality and compliance questionnaires.



Risk Management



Maintain the operational risk register.

Identify and escalate emerging risks.

Support risk reporting and business continuity documentation.



Process Documentation and Continuous Improvement



Document and improve end-to-end operational processes.

Build and maintain a centralised SOP library with appropriate document control.

Lead process improvement initiatives.

Develop, review, and maintain core operating procedures.



Performance and Contract Support



Support monthly and quarterly performance reporting.

Assist with relevant operational performance data collection and reporting.

Cross-Training and Operational Support



As part of the role, you will be systematically cross-trained to provide genuine operational backup across several functions.



Customer Service

Process sales orders.

Manage customer enquiries.

Maintain customer records.

Handle customer complaints.

Assist with COA/SDS distribution.

Purchasing

Create and track purchase orders.

Check supplier documentation.

Assist with freight-forwarder documentation.

Support order receipting and related purchasing processes.

Accounting Support

Assist with forwarding and processing relevant purchase order, warehouse, freight, and transport documentation.

Logistics

Coordinate with third-party logistics providers and warehouses as required.

Support import/export documentation and shipping coordination.

What Success Looks Like



Within the first 3–6 months, you will be expected to contribute toward:



Establishing a functioning Quality I
 database where i
 are logged, investigated, and tracked through to closure.

Developing the initial QMS framework, including the quality policy, quality manual structure, and controlled document register.

Reviewing operational processes and identifying documentation gaps.

Ensuring product compliance records are current and properly maintained.

Reviewing and maintaining the SDS library.

Establishing consistent COA review and issuance processes.

Documenting and maintaining at least 10 core SOPs.

Developing an understanding of relevant performance reporting requirements.

Becoming sufficiently cross-trained across key operational functions to provide independent backup when required.

Requirements

Essential

3+ years of experience in quality, compliance, or operations, preferably within logistics, supply chain, distribution, manufacturing, or a regulated environment.

Experience building or managing a Quality Management System (QMS) or equivalent compliance framework.

Hands-on experience with quality i
 management, root cause analysis, and CAPA.

Strong process documentation skills.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Ability to work autonomously in a remote environment while aligning with an Australian-based management team.

Desirable

ISO 9001 awareness or a formal quality qualification.

Experience with ERP/CRM systems or business reporting tools.

Knowledge of import/export and international shipping processes.

Experience in chemical distribution or another regulated industry.

Previous experience supporting an Australian or international company remotely.

Important Note on AICIS



AICIS experience is not a strict requirement.



The role involves Australian-specific regulatory requirements, including AICIS, but these can be learned on the job. What is more important is your underlying experience in regulatory compliance, quality systems, documentation management, and process control.



The Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who is:



Methodical and process-driven, with the ability to build systems that others can follow.

Self-directed and comfortable managing priorities in a remote environment.

Proactive in identifying risks, raising concerns, and driving issues through to resolution.

Highly detail-oriented when dealing with compliance, documentation, and i
 records.

Comfortable with ambiguity and building processes from scratch.

Adaptable and willing to work across different operational functions.

Collaborative and comfortable working with a remote, cross-functional team.

A strong communicator who keeps stakeholders informed.

Practical and solutions-focused, viewing quality as an opportunity for process improvement rather than simply policing compliance.

Systems and Tools



Experience with any of the following would be advantageous:



ERP and inventory management systems

CRM systems

Microsoft Office / Microsoft Excel

SharePoint

Product compliance databases

Quality and i
 management databases

Business reporting and data tools

Working Conditions

Full-time, remote position based in the Philippines

Working hours aligned with AEST

Regular communication with the Australian team via Teams and

Flexibility required across quality, compliance, and operational priorities

Occasional extended hours may be required for urgent operational or contractual requirements.

Why This Role?



This is an opportunity to join a small Australian team where you can make a tangible impact.



Rather than simply maintaining an established quality system, you will have the opportunity to help build the framework, processes, documentation, and capability from the ground up.



If you have a strong foundation in quality and compliance, enjoy creating structure where there isn't one yet, and are comfortable working across different areas of a business, this role offers the opportunity to take real ownership and grow with the organisation.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist, Long-Term Partnership Opportunity
description:
About MSTR



MSTR (
) is an AI software company based in the Netherlands and an Anthropic partner. We build custom AI software for Dutch businesses, run programs that bring AI into daily use, and ship our own products.



We are 20+ people, with a customer-facing team in the Netherlands and a remote development team in the Philippines. We are growing to 30+ people this year, and recruitment is now one of our most important processes.



This is a long-term career opportunity



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with us, not find their next gig. We invest in our people's growth and increase responsibility as you develop.



Location and type



- Remote

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, 14:00 to 23:00 Philippine time (overlapping with Netherlands business hours)

- Long-term contractor position



What you will do



You build and run our recruitment, from first outreach to a new hire's first months with us, for both the Philippine and the Dutch side. You work with the leadership team, who do the final interviews.



- Keep vacancies
 on OnlineJobs, JobStreet, LinkedIn and Kalibrr, and A/B test job posts to see what works

- Source and screen: run large-scale outreach on LinkedIn (partly automated) and handle first screenings

- Run the interview flow: plan interviews with the leadership team and keep candidates informed at every step

- Look after people after they join: run our buddy system and monthly check-ins with every team member

- Manage referrals: run our referral program and track where the best hires come from



What we are looking for



Must-have:

- 2+ years of recruitment experience, preferably for tech or IT roles

- Organized and comfortable with high volume

- Excellent English communication, written and verbal, with a warm and direct style

- You care about people staying, not just joining



Nice-to-have:

- Experience recruiting for Dutch or European companies

- Experience with recruitment automation or an ATS

- HR or onboarding experience

- Experience using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT in your work



AI tools are welcome. We are an AI company. If you use Claude, ChatGPT or similar tools to write vacancies, screen CVs, prepare interviews or automate outreach, tell us how. We would rather hire someone who uses AI well than someone who avoids it.



What we offer



- Long-term partnership: we are investing in your future with us

- Direct impact: every hire you make shapes the team for years

- A clear growth path: a buddy, monthly check-ins and room to grow into a broader people role

- Continuous learning: work at an Anthropic partner, with Claude as part of your daily work

- Freedom to propose: if something should be done differently, we want to hear it

- Flexible remote work

- A team that moves fast and takes quality seriously



How to apply



IMPORTANT: We assess candidates primarily through video responses. Please do not apply without submitting a video.



Step 1: Create a short video (3 to 7 minutes)



Record yourself answering these 5 questions:



1. Tell us about yourself: Briefly introduce yourself and how you got into recruitment.

2. A hard-to-fill role: Tell us about a role you struggled to fill. Where did you look, and how did you find the right person?

3. Keeping people: Tell us about a new hire you helped settle in, or one who left early. What did you learn about why people stay?

4. AI in your work: How do you use AI tools in recruitment today, or how would you? Where would you not trust AI to make the call?

5. Your next role: What would you like to achieve in your next role? Where do you see yourself in 5 to 10 years?



Video guidelines:

- Length: 3 to 7 minutes in total

title: Retention Accountability Operator
description:
Pay: $2,000 AUD per month

Type: Full-Time Contractor

Location: Remote

Work Hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Philippine Time



Retention Accountability Operator



About The Company

We are a digital marketing agency that runs paid advertising for small business owners across Australia and New Zealand. We currently manage over $500,000 per week in ad spend across hundreds of client accounts. Our core service is building and managing lead generation campaigns on Meta 
 and Instagram), along with building custom landing page funnels, CRM automations, and sales training systems for our clients.



We are on a mission to hit $1,000,000 per month in revenue. Churn is our biggest enemy. Every client we lose costs us roughly $5,200 per year in recurring revenue, and right now we are losing 27 clients per week. Reducing churn is the single highest-leverage initiative in the business. It adds over $1.3 million annually to the bottom line for every 2% we cut. This role exists to make that happen.



We are fast-paced. Things get done by the end of the day, not the end of the week. If a red flag is spotted at 9am, it is escalated and being acted on by 10am. We track results, not hours worked. We do not care when or how long you work. We care that the retention dashboard is accurate, red flags are caught and escalated, tasks are verified, and churn is dropping.



The Role

You are the Retention Accountability Operator. You work directly with our Integrator and your single KPI is the weekly churn rate. Your job is to own the retention dashboard, ensure every retention system is being executed across all departments, catch problems before they become cancellations, and drive accountability across the team..



You are not a manager. You do not manage people or make strategic decisions. Department leads run their teams. Your job is to check, track, report, escalate, and chase until things are resolved. You find problems and you make sure the right person fixes them. You close the loop on every single flag.



Daily Responsibilities

Data Tracking and Dashboard Ownership

Maintain and update the retention dashboard daily with all churn, refund, and red flag data

Track weekly churn rate against the target of 3.6% (down from current 5.6%)

Log every cancellation with full detail: client name, tenure, cancellation reason, red flags that preceded it, department responsible, and whether intervention was attempted

Track refund requests separately with the same level of detail

Monitor leading indicators daily: red flags raised, save conversations attempted, show rates on onboarding calls, client engagement at 14-day checkpoints, task completion rates across departments



Daily Checklist Execution

Work off a structured daily checklist that covers every retention touchpoint across all three departments (Sales, Onboarding, Ad Running)

Verify that all daily forms and checklists from department staff have been filled out

Confirm that tasks assigned to team members have been completed on time

Flag any incomplete or overdue tasks and escalate to the responsible staff member and their head manager

Ensure the daily huddle agenda is followed and red flags from the previous day are reviewed

Call Reviews Using AI

Run call recordings through ChatGPT prompts to analyze sales calls, onboarding calls, and coaching sessions

Identify over-promising, script deviations, tone issues, missed qualification steps, and compliance concerns

Generate structured reports from AI outputs and distribute to the relevant department lead

Track patterns across calls to identify systemic issues versus one-off i

Follow up with department leads to confirm flagged issues were addressed with the staff member

Message and Communication Review

Review client-facing messages sent by VAs and ads managers across 
, SMS, and

Check that Monday KPI messages were sent correctly and on time

Verify that client responses to the feedback menu options were handled properly

Ensure escalation protocols were followed when clients selected negative feedback options

Flag any communication that could damage client trust or signal an at-risk account



Accountability and Escalation

When issues are found, speak directly with the staff member responsible first

If the issue is not resolved or is repeated, escalate to their head manager

If the issue is systemic or high-risk, escalate directly to the Integrator

Track every escalation from flag to resolution and report unresolved items weekly

Hold department leads accountable for acting on flags within 24 hours of being raised

Communicate clearly and directly with the team about what is being done and what is not being done



Meeting Coverage

Cover daily huddles and weekly retention review meetings from the script when the Integrator is away

Ensure meetings stay on agenda and red flags are captured

Produce meeting notes and action items within 1 hour of the meeting ending

Follow up on action items to confirm completion by deadline



Weekly Reporting

Produce a weekly retention report every Friday covering: churn rate, refund count, red flags raised, red flags resolved, leading indicator trends, department compliance rates, and unresolved escalations

Present the report to the Integrator and business owner

Flag any trends that require strategic intervention versus tactical fixes



What We Expect

You work incredibly hard and fast. Speed matters. A red flag spotted today must be escalated today, not tomorrow.

You are obsessive about detail. A missed form or an unlogged cancellation is a failure of the system you own.

You are direct with people. When a staff member drops the ball, you tell them. You do not soften it or avoid the conversation. But you are not rude. You are clear.

You close loops. A flag is not done when it is reported. It is done when it is resolved and verified.

You do not make excuses. If the churn rate is not improving, you dig into why and surface it. You do not hide behind "the team is not cooperating." You escalate and you document.

You are comfortable using AI tools daily. ChatGPT is your analysis engine. You run the prompts, you read the outputs, you add context, and you distribute the insights.

You track results, not hours. Nobody is watching your clock. Everyone is watching your dashboard.



Skills and Requirements

Must Have

University degree or equivalent demonstrated analytical capability

Excellent written and spoken English. You will be communicating with department leads, staff members, and producing reports the business owner reads. Your communication must be clear, concise, and professional.

Strong critical thinking and pattern recognition. AI does the analysis, but you must be able to read an AI output and know whether it is relevant, whether it needs context added, and who it needs to go to.

High comfort level with AI tools, specifically ChatGPT. You will be running prompts daily and interpreting outputs.

Experience with dashboards, spreadsheets, and data tracking tools (Google Sheets, Asana, GHL)

Ability to hold people accountable without creating conflict. Direct but not aggressive. Firm but respectful.

Extremely organized. You are managing checklists, forms, logs, dashboards, and escalations across three departments simultaneously.

Fast execution. You do not let things sit. If something is flagged, it moves within the hour.



Nice to Have

Experience in a digital marketing or advertising agency environment

Familiarity with GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM

Experience with call review or quality assurance processes

Background in operations or account management



Personal Traits

Relentless work ethic. This is not a clock-in clock-out role. The dashboard does not take days off.

Thick skin. You will be telling people they missed things. Some will push back. You hold the line.

Ownership mentality. The churn rate is your number. You treat it like it is your money on the line, because it is.

Bias toward action. When in doubt, flag it and escalate. Better to over-report than miss something that costs a client.



Compensation

$2,000 AUD per month

Performance bonus tied to churn rate reduction against quarterly targets

Full-time role

Remote

Reporting Structure



Reports directly to the Integrator (Cleo)

Works across all three department leads: Head of Sales, Onboarding Team Lead, Ad Running Team Lead

Escalates systemic issues to the Integrator and business owner

Does not manage any staff. Accountability and reporting only.



Success Looks Like

Churn rate trending from 5.6% toward 3.6% within 90 days

Every cancellation logged with full detail within 24 hours

Red flags caught and escalated before cancellation in the majority of cases

Department compliance on daily checklists and forms above 95%

Weekly report produced every Friday without exception

Zero unresolved escalations older than 72 hours

The business owner never has to ask "did anyone catch this" because the answer is always yes



Send your application to

You’ll be responsible for identifying creators who fit our audience, reaching out to them, building relationships, negotiating collaborations, coordinating content, and tracking which partnerships actually produce results.

We want someone who can understand our market, research creators strategically, recognize good partnership opportunities, and eventually help own and scale our entire influencer marketing system.

title: QA Engineer, Long-Term Partnership Opportunity
description:
About MSTR



MSTR (
) is an AI software company based in the Netherlands and an Anthropic partner. We build custom AI software for Dutch businesses, run programs that bring AI into daily use, and ship our own products.



We are 20+ people, with a customer-facing team in the Netherlands and a remote development team in the Philippines. Clients rely on our products every day, so we are hiring a QA engineer whose full focus is making sure they work before anything reaches a user.



This is a long-term career opportunity



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with us, not find their next gig. We invest in our people's growth and increase responsibility as you develop.



Location and type



- Remote

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, 14:00 to 23:00 Philippine time (overlapping with Netherlands business hours)

- Long-term contractor position



What you will do



You test our most critical applications: our own products and the client applications we run under SLA. You work with the developers and project leads on every release, and you set up the testing process that the rest of the team follows.



- Test before release: run regression and release tests on web applications before they go live

- Automate: build and maintain end-to-end tests (Playwright or similar) and API tests, and run them in CI

- Test AI features: check LLM-powered features for wrong, incomplete or inconsistent output

- Report clearly: write bug reports with steps to reproduce, screenshots and expected behavior, so a developer can fix them without asking

- Set the standard: write test plans and release checklists, and make testing part of how every project ships



What we are looking for



Must-have:

- 2+ years of QA experience on web applications

- Both manual and automated testing, with a tool like Playwright, Cypress or Selenium

- API testing (Postman or similar)

- Excellent English communication, written and verbal

- Precise and persistent: you don't sign off on something you haven't checked yourself



Nice-to-have:

- Writing tests in TypeScript or Python

- Running tests in CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar)

- Experience testing AI or LLM-powered features

- Testing across browsers and screen sizes, including mobile

- Experience using AI tools like Claude or Claude Code in your work



AI tools are welcome. We are an AI company. If you use Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Copilot or similar tools to write test cases, generate test data or debug failing tests, tell us how. We would rather hire someone who uses AI well than someone who avoids it.



What we offer



- Long-term partnership: we are investing in your future with us

- Build something from scratch: you set up how MSTR tests its products, and you own quality across projects

- A clear growth path: a buddy, monthly check-ins and room to grow the QA function

- Continuous learning: work at an Anthropic partner, with Claude as part of your daily work

- Freedom to propose: if something should be done differently, we want to hear it

- Flexible remote work

- A team that moves fast and takes quality seriously



Our tech stack



- Cloud: Azure (primary), AI Foundry

- Infrastructure: Pulumi, Docker, GitHub Actions

- Back-end: Python, FastAPI

- Front-end: React, TypeScript

- Database: PostgreSQL

- AI: Claude, Azure OpenAI



How to apply



IMPORTANT: We assess candidates primarily through video responses. Please do not apply without submitting a video.



Step 1: Create a short video (3 to 7 minutes)



Record yourself answering these 5 questions:



1. Tell us about yourself: Briefly introduce yourself and how you got into QA and testing.

2. A complex feature you tested: Walk us through the most complex feature or flow you had to test. What bug did you find that a quick or generic test would have missed?

3. A test setup you built: Walk us through a test suite or testing process you set up. What did you automate, and what did you keep manual?

4. AI in your work: How do you use AI tools in your testing work today? How would you test a feature where the AI gives a different answer every time?

5. Your next role: What would you like to achieve in your next role? Where do you see yourself in 5 to 10 years?



Video guidelines:

- Length: 3 to 7 minutes in total

- Production: no need for professional quality, we want to see the real you

- Authenticity: it's fine to use AI to prepare, but talk to us in your own words. Please don't read from a script.

- Language: English (this assesses your communication skills)

- Format: any video format is fine (MP4, MOV, etc.)

- Hosting: upload to Google Drive, Dropbox, YouTube (unlisted) or similar



Step 2: Submit your application



Send the following to 



1. Your video (link or attachment)

2. Your CV / resume

3. Optional: GitHub profile, LinkedIn profile, or an example of a test plan or bug report you wrote (anonymized)



 subject: "QA Engineer Application - [Your Name]"



What happens next



1. We review your video and CV within 2 to 3 days

2. If you are a strong match, we schedule an initial interview

3. Successful candidates move to a technical evaluation with our Head of Technology

4. Final candidates meet with our founder

5. We aim to complete the entire process in 1 to 2 weeks



Who should apply



Apply if you:

- Want a long-term career in a high-performance organization

- Like finding what breaks before a user does

- Speak up early when something is at risk

- Are curious about AI and how to test it



Don't apply if you:

- Only want short-term gigs or are juggling multiple clients

- Aren't willing to create a video response

- Haven't tested web applications that real users depend on



Ready to apply? Send your video and CV to 
 are happy to answer any questions.



We look forward to learning more about you.

title: Youtube video gaming editor
description:

World of Warcraft Video Editor & Gameplay Recorder — Monthly Salary + Bonuses + Sponsorship Revenue Share



**Type of work:** [Part-time]

**Location:** Remote



**ABOUT THE ROLE**



We’re looking for a skilled video editor with World of Warcraft knowledge to take ownership of our ongoing **WoW Forever YouTube series**.



This role combines editing, playing the game, following updates and recording original gameplay. You should enjoy WoW, be committed to learning and care about creating accurate, engaging videos for its audience.



You’ll work with our content team to turn video briefs into finished videos, capturing the gameplay needed to explain each topic clearly.



**WHAT YOU’LL DO**



• Edit YouTube videos with strong openings, clear storytelling, engaging pacing and clean audio.

• Play WoW to understand the mechanics, features and changes covered in our videos.

• Record original gameplay that accurately demonstrates the narration.

• Follow relevant announcements, patch notes and community developments.

• Review briefs and scripts, flagging factual errors or unclear information before editing.

• Keep footage and project files organized.

• Meet agreed deadlines and communicate progress, questions or blockers early.

• Potentially contribute to other MMORPG series, such as AION, as the channel develops.



Playing, researching and recording are part of the role and will be considered alongside editing when agreeing on workload and compensation.



**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**



• Existing WoW knowledge and a commitment to keep learning.

• A portfolio demonstrating strong gaming or YouTube video editing.

• Confidence using Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or comparable editing software.

• Experience recording gameplay with OBS or similar software.

• A PC capable of running WoW while recording good-quality footage.

• Reliable internet for communication and transferring video files.

• Good English comprehension and clear communication.

• Attention to detail, reliability and the ability to take responsibility for an ongoing series.



**AI SKILLS & TOOLS**



Experience using **ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and ElevenLabs** is required.



**We provide all software and AI-tool subscriptions needed for the work, plus game access and the WoW subscription.**



**ACCURACY IS A CORE REQUIREMENT**



Our audience understands the game, and inaccurate information can damage the channel’s credibility.



You’ll be expected to verify factual claims using the game, official information and reliable sources. AI tools may support your workflow, but AI-generated claims must be checked before they appear in a video.



If something is uncertain, raise it with the team rather than guessing. We value someone who catches problems early, takes feedback seriously and applies corrections consistently.



**WHAT WE OFFER**



Your compensation will include three components:

title: E-Commerce B2B Inbound & Outbound Sales Representative
description:
E-Commerce B2B Inbound & Outbound Sales Representative



ABOUT US

--------------------

We are an e-commerce business specializing in hydroponic equipment serving North America. We are a small, dynamic team looking for a long-term partner who will become the primary customer representative of the company.



ABOUT THE ROLE

--------------------

We're hiring a remote dedicated B2B Sales & Client Services Representative to own the front line of sales and customer service experience.



As a key member, you'll have the opportunity to work remotely while directly shaping the success of our valued customers.



You'll answer calls, chats,
s, walk customers through our products, and close sales — while qualifying larger commercial leads for handoff to our sales manager.



Shopify is our main platform and experience is an asset



WHAT YOU'LL DO

--------------------

Answer inbound calls promptly — pick up live calls within a few rings or less.

Resolve routine retail support — shipment tracking, parts questions, order status, and general customer inquiries, start to finish.

Re-engage abandoned-cart shoppers and follow up on stalled quotes through outbound and cold calling.

Walk customers through our product lineup with clarity, confidence, and accurate detail

Work through objections, pricing pushback, and follow-ups without losing momentum, while staying alert to upsell and cross-sell openings.

Qualify incoming commercial inquiries — run a short intake call to understand scope and need, then hand off pre-qualified leads to our sales manager with clear notes.

Own the queue during scheduled leadership absences — during planned coverage windows, you're the single point of contact for all customer communications. High-value orders and urgent escalations get flagged for a same-day leadership review; everything else you handle directly.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

--------------------

Callers consistently reach a real person quickly — no missed calls, no long holds.

Retail issues get resolved on first contact whenever possible.

100% of leads are entered into the CRM, ready and pre-qualified for the sales manager.

Leadership can step away (including multi-day stretches) without customer experience slipping.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

--------------------

Experience in customer support, inside sales, or sales development — retail, e-commerce, or B2B distribution background is a plus.

Clear, confident spoken and written English communication skills, with an outgoing, people-first personality.

Sharp communication paired with genuine listening skills — comfortable being the first voice a customer hears, on the phone and in writing.

Organized and self-directed — you can triage, prioritize, and make good judgment calls without someone looking over your shoulder.

Calm, professional communication style with both everyday retail customers and commercial buyers.

Quick to learn, dependable in execution, and careful with instructions.



BONUS POINTS FOR

--------------------

Comfortable working daily inside Shopify to track orders, leads, monitor abandoned carts, and flag opportunities.

Familiarity with HubSpot or another CRM platform.

Understanding of AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude AI, etc.



HOW TO APPLY (MUST READ)

--------------------

Send the following:



Your resume

A 60–90 second voice recording (required) covering both parts below:



Voice Recording:



Record a voice note covering this specific scenario:



*A commercial facility director left a $10000 Harvest Equipment setup in their cart yesterday. You are calling them back. You are introducing yourself, and the buyer pushes pack: 



"I found the exact product in a different site for $500 less, and your delivery is 2 weeks out, I'm going to pass."



Roleplay your opening response on the phone: How do you address the price difference, protect our company's delivery value and follow through the next steps without immediately offering a discount?



We're evaluating tone, confidence, clarity, listening cues, and how naturally you move a prospect toward a close. Polish matters; perfection isn't expected — show us how you actually sound on a real call.



Applications without a voice recording that completes both parts will not be considered. Please include the word STIR in your subject line to confirm you've read this far.



Thank you.

title: Full-Time Video Editor for Two YouTube Channels (Shorts + Long-Form), $8/hr, paid weekly
description:
Our YouTube channels are growing quickly and we are looking to hire a full-time video editor to help us keep up. Our main channel covers cars and the car market: short, punchy videos built from car footage, screen recordings, voiceover, and on-screen text and data. We also run a gaming channel with narrated gameplay videos and Shorts. Both have a clear, established editing style and we will teach it to you. Please reply with "Cactus" in the subject line if you've read this far.



As our video editor you will be the person who turns raw footage and a finished voiceover into a video that keeps people watching. Your role will include the following tasks.



-Cutting vertical Shorts (under 60 seconds) from raw footage, stock and b-roll clips, and screen recordings to a recorded voiceover

-Animated captions synced to the voiceover

-On-screen text, numbers, and simple data callouts that land at the right moment

-Editing long-form videos (10-30 minutes) to a recorded voiceover

-Zooms, cuts, sound effects, and music placement that match our style

-Organizing project files and exports so anyone on the team can open them

-Simple thumbnails and end screens (bonus, not required)

-More in-depth role potential if you excel at the tasks above

-*Bonus incentives for exceptional work*



The ideal candidate is extremely detail oriented, an excellent communicator (English), well organized, fast without being sloppy, and most importantly motivated to move up in our company through exceptional work. You do not need to be a car person or a gamer, but you do need to care about pacing and retention.



Software: any editor is fine as long as you deliver an MP4. We work in DaVinci Resolve, so Resolve is preferred because it lets you share project files with the rest of the team. If you use something else, tell us what.



Hours and pay:

-Part time starting, 40 hours per week

-Monday to Friday, 5:00 PM to 1:00 AM Pacific time (8:00 AM to 4:00 PM Manila)

-$8.00 USD per hour, paid every week

-Performance review at 90 days with a path to $10.00 per hour

-13th month bonus after one year with us



There will be in-depth training on our editing style and procedures and interviews with the CEO. We will also provide reference videos and training videos to watch. Please add to the subject line "Violin" as well if you've read this far.



If interested in this role, please reply with ALL of the following:



1. A screenshot of your internet speed from speedtest.net

2. A 30 second voice sample where you start the recording with "Ok here's the deal" and then explain why you're the best fit for the job

3. A link to your portfolio (YouTube videos or Shorts you have edited, with a note on what you did on each)

4. The editing software you use

5. Your finished editing exercise (details below)



EDITING EXERCISE



Open this folder: 



Inside you'll find raw footage, a voiceover, and one finished reference video. Your job is to make a vertical Short from the raw footage and the voiceover that looks and feels like the reference.



Requirements:

1. Vertical 9:16, 1080x1920, MP4 (H.264), under 60 seconds. If it is 60.5 seconds it is over.

2. Use the voiceover exactly as provided. You may trim silence between lines but not remove or reorder any words.

3. Animated word-by-word captions synced to the voiceover, styled like the reference.

4. Pick the best moments from the raw footage to match what the voice is saying. Not everything in the folder belongs in the Short.

5. Match the reference's pacing, caption style, zoom and cut rhythm, and sound design as closely as you can.

6. In the last 2 seconds, put your first name in small text in the bottom-right corner.

7. Name the file FIRSTNAME_short_v1.mp4

8. Upload it to your own Google Drive or as an unlisted YouTube video and put the link in your application. Do not upload into our folder.



We will judge, in this order: did you follow every requirement, how close you got to the reference, whether the Short holds attention, and how quickly you delivered.



Applications missing any of the five items above will not be reviewed.

title: Professional Copywriter / Writer - Project-Based Digital Marketing Work - Include Video Intro
description:
**MUST SUBMIT VIDEO APPLICATION**



We’re looking for an experienced professional writer to work with us on an ongoing project basis.



Most of the work sits within the digital marketing and online advertising industry, so we’re looking for someone who can understand the subject at a deeper level rather than simply rewrite information found online.



The work



You’ll work across a mix of:



Ghostwritten articles for the owner of a digital advertising business

Commentary on digital marketing and advertising news

Research-heavy articles and opinion pieces

Educational content covering more advanced marketing concepts

Other written content based on interviews, recordings, research and supplied briefs

You won’t be responsible for publishing, uploading or managing the content. We have a team for that. Your focus is the research and writing.



What we're looking for:



Writing ability is the most important part of this role.



You should be able to:



Write clearly, concisely and with personality

Research a topic properly rather than relying on surface-level summaries

Understand advanced digital marketing and online advertising concepts

Keep up with industry news and developments

Ghostwrite convincingly in someone else's voice

Turn technical or complicated ideas into writing that is easy to follow without dumbing them down

Follow a detailed brief closely

Produce accurate first drafts without requiring extensive rewriting

Take feedback well and apply it consistently to future work

Communicate comfortably on video calls when discussing briefs, ideas or feedback

Be available for scheduled video meetings when required





Your writing style:



We don't want generic corporate content or writing that feels like it came straight out of ChatGPT.



Using AI as part of your process is completely fine. We use it too.



What matters is the finished product.



You need to know how to take research, source material and AI-assisted drafts and turn them into writing that feels natural, specific and human. The final piece should have a point of view, rhythm and personality rather than sounding templated.



A major part of the role will also be learning the owner's writing and speaking style and being able to reproduce that voice consistently.



Digital marketing knowledge



Previous experience writing within digital marketing is strongly preferred.



You don't necessarily need to be a hands-on media buyer, but you should be comfortable researching and understanding topics involving areas such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, paid media, creative, tracking, attribution, AI and broader developments within digital marketing.



We need someone who can understand what they're writing about, question things that don't make sense and identify what deserves further research.



This could become substantial ongoing work



We're hiring on a project basis initially, but there is plenty of writing work available.



For someone who can consistently understand the brief, capture the right voice and deliver strong work with minimal revisions, there is an opportunity for regular ongoing projects.



How to apply



Please send:



A short video introduction about your writing experience

Your experience writing about digital marketing, advertising or related subjects

A portfolio or links to relevant published work

Examples of ghostwriting, research-heavy or thought-leadership work if available

Your availability

Your project or hourly rate



Please don't send only generic SEO blog samples. We're particularly interested in seeing work that demonstrates research, judgement, concise writing and the ability to develop a distinct voice. Include the words DG writer in your subject title when applying.

title: REO Portal Virtual Assistant Equator Pyramid RESNET Cascade
description:
We are a high volume real estate brokerage specializing in foreclosure, REO, and institutional listings. Our team works directly with asset managers, lenders, and government entities and operates in fast paced, compliance driven environment. Accuracy, consistency, and follow through are critical in this role. This is a long term opportunity for the right virtual assistant who wants stability, growth, and real responsibility in the REO space.



We are seeking an organized, detail driven Virtual Assistant to handle foreclosure and REO tasking across multiple client portals. Accuracy is crucial in this role. This position supports properties from assignment through closing and requires strong follow through, deadline management, and the ability to work independently within structured systems. The ideal candidate is comfortable working in portals, following task checklists, and maintaining compliance without constant oversight.



Primary responsibilities include completing all required tasks in REO and foreclosure portals, maintaining daily updates and status changes, monitoring deadlines and escalation requirements, and accurately uploading documents, photos, bids, and reports. You will be responsible for maintaining compliance across all client instructions and identifying missing or incorrect items before they become issues. Strong comprehension is needed in this position.



This role also includes coordinating with field staff and vendors, ordering inspections, occupancy checks, preservation services, and repair bids, and following up as needed. Inspections and bids must be reviewed for completeness and obvious discrepancies before submission. You will assist with BPO tasking and organization, including managing photos, comparable data, and required documentation.



Additional responsibilities include coordinating utility turn ons and shut offs, requesting HOA payoff statements and resale disclosures, assisting with title related items such as deeds, tax information, and lien data, supporting MLS data entry and updates when needed, and maintaining accurate internal records and tracking.



Prior experience with REO, foreclosure, or bank owned properties is required. Candidates must have hands on experience working inside REO client portals and a strong understanding of task based workflows, deadlines, and compliance requirements. Applicants should be prepared to list which portals they have worked in, how long they have handled REO or foreclosure files, and the types of tasks they managed on a daily basis.



Strong attention to detail, excellent written communication, and the ability to work independently are essential. This role requires someone who is organized, reliable, and comfortable with repetitive, accuracy driven work. Candidates must be able to troubleshoot issues as they arise and communicate clearly when escalation is needed.



Technical requirements include reliable high speed internet, a quiet home work environment, and proficiency with Google Workspace. Comfort using PDFs, spreadsheets, cloud storage, and task driven systems is required.



This is a full time position during Arizona, United States business hours. We offer a stable long term role with clear systems, structured training on our workflows and clients, and opportunities to grow into higher level REO coordination and oversight positions.



To apply, please include a brief summary of your REO or foreclosure experience, a list of portals you have worked in such as Equator, Pyramid, RESNET, Bid on Homes, or similar systems, and your availability to work United States business hours. Qualified candidates will be provided with a link to officially apply in our database.

title: AI Video Creator / Stop-Motion Style Storyteller (Full Time)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

We are building a small studio of original YouTube channels and character worlds made entirely with AI video tools. Think cozy, handmade, stop-motion style: tiny felt or toy-like characters cooking, eating, building, and living calm little lives. No voiceovers, no talking heads. Just beautiful scenes, satisfying moments, and the right music.



We are looking for one full-time creator who can take a single idea from concept to finished, upload-ready video, every day. You will storyboard, generate, and edit. You will also help invent the characters and worlds themselves, so imagination matters as much as technical skill.



You will own both sides of the content: relaxing long-form videos for YouTube, and fast, scroll- stopping short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Long form builds the world. Short form brings new people into it and makes them fall in love with the characters.



This is a long-term role. The worlds we build will grow beyond YouTube over time, and we want someone who wants to grow with them.



The style we are going for

Please watch these before you apply. If you watch them and think “I can make that, and I can make it better,” you are who we want to hear from.

• 
 • 

  

What makes these work:

• The world feels real and touchable. Wool fibers, felt textures, tiny wooden spoons, warm lamp light, steam rising off food. Every frame looks like a handmade miniature set.

• The characters stay consistent. Same face, same outfit, same proportions in every shot, across every episode.

• The pacing is slow and satisfying. Chopping, stirring, pouring, plating, eating. Each step gets its moment. Viewers watch for 30+ minutes to relax.

• The music carries the mood. Gentle, warm, well chosen. No narration needed.

• The food is accurate. If a character makes tacos al pastor, the steps and ingredients make

sense. A real cook would nod along.



What you will do

Long form (YouTube)

• Brainstorm and pitch episode ideas, characters, and settings for multiple channels

• Write simple shot lists and storyboards for each video

• Generate images and video clips using AI tools (Higgsfield, Kling, Veo, Midjourney, Nano Banana, or similar)

• Keep characters, sets, and style consistent across hundreds of shots

• Edit everything into long-form videos (roughly 20 to 60 minutes) with smooth pacing, music, and ambient sound

• Select and license music that fits the mood

• Create thumbnails and suggest titles that make people want to click

• Publish on a consistent daily schedule and keep an organized library of characters, prompts, and assets

• Watch what performs and suggest improvements



Short form (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts)

• Cut our long-form videos into short, addictive clips with strong hooks in the first 1 to 2 seconds

• Create original short-form content built for each platform, not just reposts

• Experiment with formats that get people watching, commenting, and sharing: oddly satisfying loops, “brain rot” style edits, trends, memes, quizzes, “guess the recipe,” “which character are you,” polls, and series that keep people coming back

• Use short form to drive viewers to the full-length videos on YouTube

• Build real fans of our characters: give them personalities, running jokes, and moments people want to comment on and share

• Track views, watch time, saves, shares, and comments, and double down on what works



Who you are

• You have already made AI video content you are proud of, and you can show it

• You know how to keep a character consistent across many AI generations (reference images, character sheets, image-to-video workflows, etc.)

• You are a strong video editor (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, Final Cut, or similar)

• You have taste. You can tell when a shot looks “AI weird” and you fix it or cut it

• You love cozy, cute, and satisfying content: stop-motion, miniatures, Ghibli, Sylvanian Families, Animal Crossing, food ASMR, that whole world

• You are strongly connected to pop culture and know what is trending with audiences in the US and globally

• You spend real time on TikTok and Instagram, and you understand why some videos get millions of views and others die at 200

• You know how to write a hook and edit for retention: fast cuts, loops, captions, sound choices, and trending audio

• Excellent written and spoken English

• You are fast, organized, and reliable. Daily output is part of the job

• You get excited about inventing characters, names, backstories, and little worlds



Nice to have

• Experience growing channels/pages (yours or a client’s)

• Short-form videos you made that went viral or performed well (send the links and the numbers)

• Experience building a character or mascot account that people follow for the character itself

• Pop culture knowledge 

• Real cooking or baking knowledge

• Illustration, character design, or 3D background

• Experience with AI music tools or sound design

• Experience writing prompts at scale and building reusable prompt libraries

  

How to apply

 We only want to talk to people who are confident they can create in this style. To be considered, your application must include:

1. Your portfolio. Links to AI video work you made, both long form and short form. If you have something in a felt, clay, toy, or stop-motion style, put it first. For short-form work, include view counts if you have them.

2. A short sample (optional but strongly preferred). A 15 to 60 second clip of one cozy character doing one satisfying task (cooking, baking, building, cleaning) in a handmade miniature style. Applicants who send a sample go to the top of the list.

3. Your tool stack. Which AI tools and editing software you use, and which ones you pay for. 4. One original idea. Describe a character and a world you would create for a channel like

this, in 3 to 5 sentences. Give the character a name.

5. Three things from pop culture right now that you think a channel like this could learn from, and why.

6. Three short-form video ideas. Using one of the reference videos above, describe three TikTok or Reels ideas you would make from it. For each one, tell us the hook (what happens in the first 2 seconds) and why people would comment or share.



Start your application with the words “Tiny Worlds” so we know you read the full posting. Applications without this will not be reviewed.
salary: Negotiable, based on portfolio and skill

title: Local SEO & Digital Marketing Generalist
description:
Primary Focus: Local SEO, Google Maps, Website SEO, Content, Reputation, and Organic Growth



Position Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Local SEO & Digital Marketing Generalist to manage and grow the online presence of our California, USA -based Upscale Sandwich Chain and its 6 storefront locations. Sandwicheez has been in operation since 2010 and now ready to grow across California and other Parts of USA. 



You will build and execute tailored Local SEO strategies for each individual location while maintaining a strong, unified brand presence across all locations. A key part of the role will be developing and optimizing local-focused content that connects with customers in each community, improves local search visibility, and drives more traffic and visits to our stores.



Key Responsibilities

1. Multi-Location Local SEO & Google Maps Management

 Google Business Profile (GBP): Manage, audit, and continuously optimize profiles for all 6 locations. Publish regular GBP posts for specials, menu updates, and catering promotions.

 Hyper-Local Strategy: Develop location-specific SEO strategies tailored to Oakland and San Ramon neighborhoods, ensuring distinct geographic targeting and high-intent keyword ranking (e.g., lunch, takeout, corporate/event catering).

 Location Landing Pages: Create and maintain dedicated website pages for each storefront complete with accurate NAP (Name, Address, Phone), localized content, directions, and Restaurant/Local Business structured data (schema).



2. On-Page, Website & Technical SEO

 On-Page Optimization: Optimize title tags, meta descriptions, headings, image alt text, internal links, and menu/catering pages for search relevance and conversions.

 CMS & Technical Health: Make basic content updates, monitor Google Search Console for indexing/crawling issues, and coordinate with developers for complex fixes.



3. Citation Management, Reviews & Reputation

 Local Listings: Ensure accurate, consistent NAP data across Yelp, Apple Maps, Google, and relevant food/directory platforms. Resolve duplicate or outdated citations.

 Reputation Tracking: Monitor customer reviews across platforms, assist store managers with professional responses, track review trends per location, and support strategies to gather genuine reviews.



4. SEO Content, Outreach & Market Research

 Localized Content: Plan and write SEO-friendly resources (e.g., catering guides, meeting/event lunch guides, local food articles) that drive organic traffic and conversions.

 Competitor Intelligence: Monitor local competitors, analyze their local search visibility and keyword strategy, and provide actionable recommendations.

 Local Outreach: Pursue quality, legitimate local backlinks and partnerships through community involvement, local events, and sponsorships.



5. Analytics & Performance Reporting

 Metrics Tracking: Monitor organic traffic, Google Maps performance (calls, clicks, directions), keyword rankings, and catering leads using GA4, GSC, GBP Insights, and SEO tools.

 Business-Focused Reporting: Deliver clear, non-technical monthly reports connecting SEO activities directly to store traffic and business revenue.



6. General Digital Marketing Support

 Provide cross-functional support for website updates,
 marketing, online promotions, social media coordination, and basic digital asset management as needed.





Qualifications & Requirements

Required:

 5+ years of hands-on SEO and Digital Marketing experience, specifically focused on Local SEO and Multi-Location management (5 or 6+ physical storefronts).

 The candidate must have great writing skillset 

 Proven track record optimizing Google Business Profiles, Google Maps, and local citations and directory experience.

 Strong on-page SEO skills, keyword research capability, and localized content writing experience.

 Proficient with GA4, Google Search Console, and SEO tools and platforms

 Familiarity with restaurant/local business schema markup.

 Excellent written communication and project management skills; ability to work independently.

 Direct experience in the restaurant, food service, catering, or franchise industries is a huge plus.

 Experience with backlinks or link building and internal linking is highly preferred.





DO NOT APPLY IF YOU DO NOT HAVE THESE QUALIFICATIONS. APPLICANTS WITH NO ACTUAL SEO EXPERIENCE WILL NOT BE ACCOMMODATED.



Core Ownership Breakdown

 Primary (70%): Local SEO, GBP/Google Maps, Multi-Location Strategy, On-Page SEO, Citations & Reputation, Local Content, SEO Analytics.

 Secondary / Generalist (30%): CMS Updates,
/Digital Marketing Support, Local Outreach, General Marketing Support.

title: Client Success Manager
description:
Get to know who we serve before you apply:


 




 

WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT



Most "support" roles are a ticket queue. A client complains, you copy-paste a reply, you close the ticket, you forget the human.



Market Leaders doesn't work that way.



Our clients are high-performing operators — property agents, financial advisors, business owners — who pay us to help them grow. They don't need a help desk. They need someone in their corner who keeps them on track, removes the friction, and finds the thing they couldn't find themselves.



That's you.



You're the person who notices a client has gone quiet and reaches out before they fall behind. You're the one who walks them through the tool they're stuck on. You're the one who, when a client says "I can't figure out how to do X," just... handles it.



If you're genuinely tech-savvy, genuinely organised, and you actually like helping people win — read on.



This is a fully remote role for someone who takes ownership, not someone who waits for tickets.



ABOUT MARKET LEADERS

Market Leaders is a Singapore-based social media consulting company. We help high-performing operators turn their expertise into content and systems that compound.



We work with:

- **Property agents** doing $500M+ in transactions, leading 30+ agent teams

- **Financial advisors** running established lead and ad systems

- **Business owners + coaches** building personal brands that drive real revenue



We teach the 5 C's — Character, Content, Community, Convert, Client — and we believe in systems, not willpower. Peaceful and profitable.



Here's the truth about coaching: the clients who get results are the ones who keep showing up and doing the work. Your job is to make that easy — to keep them accountable, unblock them on the tech, and be the reliable hand they can reach for. You protect the client relationship so our coaches and founders can focus on the coaching.





TOTAL COMPENSATION PACKAGE



**Base Salary:** SGD $800-1,000/month (paid via Wise or PayPal in SGD)

Range depends on experience and how much you can own from day one.



**What's Included**

- Fully remote — work from anywhere, as long as you overlap Singapore working hours (SGT)

- Direct training on our tools, our AI bots, our client systems, and how we work

- Exposure to how a real coaching business runs — the systems behind the scenes

- The tools you need to do the job well



**Work Benefits**

- Results-focused — we judge whether clients stay on track and feel supported, not your hours online

- Clear playbooks so you're never guessing how to handle something

- A role where being proactive and resourceful is the whole point, not a bonus



**Path Forward**

- Prove you can own the client relationship, and the scope grows — more clients, more responsibility, a senior customer-success track

- This is a long-term seat for the right person, not a gig





THE 4Rs — YOUR ROLE BREAKDOWN



### 1. ROLE — The Mission



Be the accountability and support layer for Market Leaders' clients.



You keep clients on track with what they committed to, you help them with the tech and tools they get stuck on, and you find the things they can't find for themselves. You're the reliable, proactive hand that makes the client experience feel handled.



Every interaction serves one objective: the client keeps moving forward, feels supported, and stays with us because the experience is excellent.



You'll use our AI tools and systems to help clients faster — but the care, the follow-through, and the judgment are yours.



### 2. RESPONSIBILITIES — The Day-to-Day Work



**Accountability & Check-ins — 35%**

- Track what each client committed to (from their coaching calls, client chart, and ongoing chats)

- Work inside client chats — reach out proactively, nudge, follow up, and check in before things slip

- Run a consistent weekly check-in rhythm with clients

- Log progress so the coaches and founders always know where each client stands



**Tech Support & Enablement — 30%**

- Help clients set up and use our tools, AI bots, portal, and the software they need

- Troubleshoot when something isn't working, calmly and clearly

- Run short screen-share walkthroughs when a client is stuck

- Write simple how-to guides so the same question doesn't come up twice



**Concierge & Research — 20%**

- Find the things clients can't find — resources, templates, vendors, answers, examples

- Do light research on the client's behalf so they don't lose time hunting

- Be the "let me sort that out for you" person clients come to rely on



**CRM Hygiene & Escalation — 15%**

- Keep the client chart, records, notes, and statuses clean and up to date

- Flag at-risk or quiet clients early

- Escalate the right things to coaches or founders — with context, not just "client's upset"



### 3. RESULTS — What Success Looks Like



**Foundation Phase — Month 1**

- Know the client roster, their commitments, and the tools they use

- Hit a consistent response time on every client message

- Learn our systems, AI bots, and playbooks well enough to handle common questions solo

- Run your first round of weekly check-ins



*This phase is about learning the clients, the tools, and the rhythm.*



**Growth Phase — Month 3**

- Own the weekly accountability loop — clients are being followed up with, on time, every week

- Resolve most tech questions yourself without escalating

- Build a small library of how-to guides for the questions that repeat

- Spot at-risk clients early and flag them with useful context



*This phase is where you stop reacting and start running the support engine.*



**Long-Term Impact — Month 6**

- Measurably lift client follow-through — clients are doing what they committed to

- Noticeably cut the number of routine questions reaching the founders and coaches

- Be the trusted point of contact clients reach for first

- Own the client-experience playbook and keep improving it



*This phase is where the client experience runs as a system you own.*



### 4. REQUIREMENTS — The Must-Haves



**Experience**

- Prior customer-facing experience — customer success, account management, support, or client coordination

- A track record of being the reliable, proactive one — examples welcome

- Comfortable working directly with clients who are busy, successful, and expect competence



**Skills**

- Excellent written and spoken English — most of this job is clear communication

- Genuinely tech-savvy — you learn new software and AI tools fast and can troubleshoot calmly

- Strongly organised — you don't drop follow-ups, and nothing falls through the cracks

- Resourceful — when you don't know something, you find out, you don't just give up



**Work Arrangement**

- Fully remote, but you must overlap core Singapore working hours (SGT) for client responsiveness

- Reliable laptop and internet — clients are counting on you to be reachable

- Able to commit long-term, not a short gig



**Work Style**

- Ownership mentality — a client's progress is your responsibility, not just your task list

- Proactive — you reach out before you're asked, you don't wait for problems to escalate

- Calm and warm under pressure — clients should feel handled, not managed

- Open to feedback and fast iteration — you'd rather hear "do this better" than "this is fine"





WHAT MAKES YOU THE PERFECT FIT

**You Take Ownership**

You don't ask "did I reply?" You ask "is this client actually moving forward?" Their progress is your scoreboard.



**You're Genuinely Good with Tech**

New tool, new AI bot, unfamiliar software — you figure it out fast, and you can explain it to someone who can't. You're the person friends call when something won't work.



**You're Proactive, Not Reactive**

You notice the quiet client. You follow up before the deadline. You flag the problem while it's still small. Clients never have to chase you.



**You're Resourceful**

"I couldn't find it" isn't in your vocabulary. When a client needs something, you go find it, figure it out, or get the answer.



**You're Organised to a Fault**

You track every commitment and every follow-up. Nothing slips. Your notes are clean enough that anyone could pick them up.



**You're Warm Without Being a Pushover**

You can hold a client accountable and keep them feeling supported at the same time. You're a direct, caring mentor, not a doormat and not a drill sergeant.



**You Communicate Clearly**

Whether it's a check-in, a how-to, or an escalation, your message is clear, kind, and gets to the point.





HOW TO APPLY



Fill out this form: 



NOT A FIT IF

This role is not for you if:

- You want a passive ticket-queue job where you wait for problems to come to you

- You need someone watching over you to stay on task — remote means self-managed

- You're not actually comfortable with software and troubleshooting

- You drop follow-ups or let things fall through the cracks

- You can't overlap Singapore working hours for client responsiveness

- You'd rather avoid hard conversations than hold a client accountable

- You want a short gig, not a long-term seat



If any of those describe you, that's fine. We'd rather know upfront.
