title: Appointment Setter / Phone Caller (US Home Remodeling): Base + Commission, Excellent US Accent Required
description:
Appointment Setter / Phone Caller (US Home Remodeling): Base + Commission, Path to Full Time

We're a US marketing agency that runs
 and Google ads for home remodeling companies (kitchens, bathrooms, full renovations). Our ads bring in homeowners who want a quote. Your job is to call them fast, qualify them, and book them for an in-home estimate with our client.

This is a phone job. You will be talking to American homeowners all day, so your accent and how you sound are the #1 thing we hire for. Our operations manager handles all the backend work (building systems, client accounts, software). She will train you and manage you day to day. Your only job is the phone.



What You'll Be Doing

Calling new homeowner leads within minutes of when they come in (they just filled out a form asking for a quote)

Asking a short list of qualifying questions: what project, budget, timeline, are they the homeowner

Booking qualified homeowners onto our client's calendar for an in-home estimate

Making a short recorded confirmation call so the homeowner says "yes, I'll be there"

Following our script word for word, including the call-recording disclosure at the start of every call

Logging every call and outcome in our CRM (GoHighLevel). If it isn't logged, it didn't happen.

Following up with no-answers based on our follow-up schedule

Following US calling-hour rules on every single call (see below)

You'll be working from our exact script and real example calls. We'll share recordings so you can hear:

The tone we want (friendly, confident, never pushy)

How fast a call should move

What a "qualified" homeowner sounds like and what a bad fit sounds like



Calling Hours (Very Important)

We have clients all over the US, from the East Coast to the West Coast, so our homeowners live in different time zones (Eastern, Central, Mountain, Pacific, and Arizona, which doesn't change its clocks). You have to check every homeowner's time zone before you dial, and be ready for your schedule to shift as we add clients in new parts of the country.

US law limits when businesses can call people. Our rule is stricter than the law so we never get in trouble:

Only call between 9am and 8pm in the HOMEOWNER'S local time. Not your time, not Eastern time. A homeowner in Arizona or California is 2–3 hours behind New York.

If a lead comes in after 8pm their time, do not call. Call them first thing the next day, as close to 9am their time as you can.

Sundays: only call between 12pm and 8pm their time.

The best time to reach most homeowners is 5pm–8pm their time, right after work. Expect to make a lot of calls in that window.

Breaking this rule even once is grounds for being let go. No exceptions.



Requirements

Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral accent that is easy for Americans to understand. This is non-negotiable.

Phone experience: appointment setting, call center, customer service, or sales calls

Available during US afternoon and evening hours, roughly 2pm–11pm US Eastern (2am–11am Philippine time). Homeowners work 9-to-5, so the best time to reach them is after 5–6pm in their own time zone. As we add West Coast clients, the shift will run later (8pm Pacific = 11pm Eastern), so you need to be flexible with your hours.

Quiet place to work, a good headset, and stable internet with a backup (mobile data or a second connection)

Follows a script exactly and takes feedback without getting defensive

Honest. We review recorded calls every week. If you fake a booking or pressure someone into one, you're done.



Bonus (not required, but a big plus):

Experience calling US homeowners (home services, solar, roofing, HVAC, real estate, insurance)

Experience with GoHighLevel or any CRM dialer

Have done "speed to lead" calling on inbound leads before



Compensation & Growth

Base salary: $300/month, paid weekly (about $69 every Friday)

Commission: $10 for every confirmed appointment, paid monthly. That means the homeowner is booked on the calendar and said yes on our recorded confirmation call. Uncapped.

Paid trial: The first 2 weeks are a paid trial. You get paid the same as the job itself: your weekly base (about $69/week) plus $10 for every confirmed appointment. At the end of the 2 weeks, either side can d
 it's not a fit, no hard feelings.

Raise: Once you're full-time and hitting your numbers, your base goes up.

Growth: As we add clients, you get more leads, which means more commission. Our top performer moves to full-time with a higher base. We're hiring 1 person now and will add more callers under whoever proves themselves first.

Example: 20 confirmed appointments in a month = $300 + $200 = $500. 40 confirmed = $700. More clients means more leads, so that number goes up.

We pay for confirmed appointments only, not dials, not hours on the phone, not bookings that never get confirmed. If a confirmation turns out to be fake, it's taken back. We want people who book real homeowners who actually show up.



How To Apply:

Applications that don't follow these steps will not be read.

Record a Loom video (2–4 minutes) with your camera ON where you:

Introduce yourself

Tell us your phone experience: what kind of calls, who you called, how many per day

Read the script below out loud like you're on a real call with an American homeowner

Then answer this objection out loud, in your own words: "Can you just give me a price over the phone?"

Send us:

Your Loom link (make sure it's set to "anyone with the link can view")

Your availability in US Eastern Time (which hours, which days)

Your internet speed (screenshot of a speedtest.net result)

Start your application with the words "Remodix Caller" so we know you read this far

The script to read in your Loom:

"Hi, is this Sarah? Hey Sarah, this is [your name] calling from the remodeling team. Just a heads up, this call is recorded for quality. You filled out a form a few minutes ago about redoing your bathroom, is that right? Perfect. I've just got a couple quick questions so we send the right person out. Are you the homeowner? Great. And are you looking to get this started in the next few months, or is it more down the road? Got it. What we do next is have one of our project managers come out, look at the space, and give you an exact price, no guesswork. I've got Tuesday at 10am or Wednesday at 4pm. Which one works better for you?"



If you sound like someone an American homeowner would happily stay on the phone with, and you want to earn more as we grow, we want to hear from you.



P.S. We are a small, fast-growing team. We care about results and honesty more than anything. Show up, follow the system, book real appointments, and you'll grow with us.

title: Short Form Video Editor | Long-Term, $1000-1300 /month
description:

We're Dreaver. We're a lifestyle brand, that currently sells treadmills and other fitness equipment for the home, direct to people who want to move more without a gym membership or the pressure from booking a class. We run ads in the Netherlands, Denmark and Sweden — more markets can follow. Creative is the lever that moves the needle for us, and we are looking for a loyal editor to own our video output long-term.



This is direct-response editing, not video production. If your scope is weddings, corporate or long-form YouTube, we won't be a good client for you.



What you'd be doing

Cutting UGC, founder footage and mash-ups into Meta ads, 9:16 and 4:5. Hook variants tested against each other. Editing to AI voiceover with clean sync and pacing. Comfortable with AI b-roll or AI UGC shot from Higgsfield, made to not look like AI. Captions, pattern interrupts, retention pacing, end cards. Re-cutting winners into new angles instead of starting from zero.



Multiple markets | NL, DK, SE, ...

Native translators on the team handle scripting and copy per market, you don't need to write or speak Dutch, Danish or Swedish. A creative sense for scripting and concepting, someone who can push back on a script or suggest a better opening, is a big plus.



How we work

Ownership matters, you don't wait for a brief to fix what you can already see.

Speed. We'd rather test fast than think long. We learn by doing and improve as we go.

Proactive. You don't wait around. You spot opportunities, flag problems, and act.

Fix > perfect. See something that could be better? Fix it. Perfection isn't the requirement, progress is.



Tools

Premiere Pro or CapCut, non-negotiable. Comfortable with Higgsfield and ElevenLabs for the occasional AI shot and voice-overs. We're not hiring an AI specialist, just someone who won't freeze the first time AI footage lands in their timeline. When working together, we pay for all AI subscriptions, on our accounts.



What we offer

- Full-time

- $
per month, depending on level

- Perform well and you grow with us. More scope, better pay.

- Work when you work best. No fixed hours, just deadlines and a few hours overlap with Amsterdam CET

How to apply

 
 with the subject line in exactly this format:

[Your name] | [years editing DR ads] | [months using Higgsfield] | [length in seconds of the AI video you're sending]

Example: Anna Nowak | 3 | 7 | 24



Then in the body, exactly these six lines and nothing else. No cover letter, no CV, no attachments — links only.



1. Best UGC or founder ad you've edited:

title: FULL-TIME PODCAST PRODUCTION ASSISTANT & VIDEO EDITOR
description:
ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY



We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented person to join our podcast and media production team full-time.



You will help turn interviews into professional video clips, support podcast publishing, and keep our production workflow organized.



You will initially work on:

• The Amazing Authorities Podcast

• Booked For TV

• Client interviews featuring CEOs, authors, speakers, consultants, and experts



You will work with Mitch Carson, an author, international speaker, TV host, and podcast coach, alongside our production team.



We can teach our tools and processes. What you must bring is excellent English, a constructive attitude, reliability, and a keen eye for detail.



WHY JOIN OUR TEAM?



• Full-time work with an established podcast and media team.

• Daytime working hours in the Philippines.

• Paid onboarding and training in our production workflow.

• Clear instructions, branding examples, templates, and checklists.

• Regular team communication and support.

• An increase from $3 to $4 per hour after successfully completing the first 30 days.

• Opportunities to develop new skills and take on greater responsibility.



This is not an advanced animation or cinematic-editing position. Our priority is accurate, polished content and dependable production support.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALITIES



Excellent spoken and written English

Clear communication is essential. Correct spelling, punctuation, and grammar matter in every message, caption, description, and other communication with our team and clients.



A positive, solution-focused attitude

We want someone who approaches challenges by asking what can be done and suggesting practical next steps. Questions, honest feedback, and early reporting of problems are welcome. We expect respectful communication without gossip, blame, or unnecessary conflict.



A keen eye for detail

You should notice caption mistakes, misspelled names, incorrect branding, awkward framing, missing information, and disorganized files. Check your work before submitting it.



Reliability and accountability

Be punctual, attend scheduled calls, meet deadlines, and communicate promptly. If you encounter a problem, tell us early.



Willingness to learn

Follow instructions, ask when something is unclear, accept feedback professionally, and apply what you learn to future assignments.



Good organization

Keep files easy to locate, follow naming conventions, maintain accurate task updates, and use production checklists.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE — HELPFUL, NOT REQUIRED



Experience with any of the following is a plus:

• CapCut and/or OpusClip.

• Canva video editing and basic branded graphics.

• Spotify for Creators, formerly Spotify for Podcasters or Anchor.

• Riverside.

• Podcast publishing and production support.

• Caption correction and short-form video editing.

• YouTube uploads and scheduling.

• Google Drive, Google Sheets, or similar organizational tools.



Other production skills can be taught. Applicants with excellent English, strong attention to detail, and the right attitude are encouraged to apply even if they have not used every tool.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



Video editing and clip creation:

• Upload complete interviews into OpusClip.

• Review suggested clips and select compelling moments.

• Create approximately three vertical shorts per assigned interview.

• Polish clips in CapCut using our workflow.

• Correct caption spelling, punctuation, grammar, names, and technical terms.

• Frame speakers correctly for vertical video.

• Remove unnecessary pauses and improve weak openings without changing the speaker’s meaning.

• Apply approved logos, fonts, colors, and closing screens.

• Create basic 3–5-minute highlight videos when requested.

• Watch completed videos and check them before submission.



Podcast production support:

• Help set up and manage company- or client-owned Spotify for Creators accounts and shows.

• Upload and schedule approved episodes.

• Add approved titles, descriptions, artwork, guest details, and links.

• Learn our podcast hosting and distribution procedures.

• Check published episodes and links for accuracy.

• Assist with Riverside recordings and production files as trained.

• Flag missing information, incomplete uploads, or publishing problems.

• Follow our approval process before publishing content.



Organization and teamwork:

• Follow our file-naming and folder system.

• Organize recordings, project files, and final exports.

• Keep the production tracker updated.

• Maintain clear handoff notes and task status.

• Attend daily Zoom video calls with the team.

• Make requested corrections and apply feedback.

• Communicate professionally with team members and clients as assigned.



OUR EDITING STYLE



Our audience includes business owners, authors, executives, and professional experts. Videos should feel polished, credible, and engaging.



We prefer:

• A strong opening within the first three seconds.

• Clean, readable, accurate captions.

• Natural pacing and clear storytelling.

• Tasteful zooms and reframing.

• Selective emphasis of important words.

• Consistent branding.

• Appropriate closing screens and calls to action.



Avoid excessive emojis, distracting transitions, unnecessary sound effects, and frantic editing.



Every clip should make sense on its own and accurately represent what the guest said.



REQUIRED EQUIPMENT AND WORK ENVIRONMENT



You must have:

• Reliable internet service suitable for daily Zoom video calls and large video uploads and downloads.

• A newer-model laptop or desktop capable of running our editing tools and handling long podcast recordings reliably.

• A working webcam and a clear microphone or headset.

• A quiet work environment where you can concentrate and participate in daily team video calls without frequent interruptions.

• A practical backup plan for internet or power interruptions.



Please include your computer specifications and internet speeds in your application.



SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION



• Working days: Monday–Friday.

• Working hours: 9:00 AM–6:00 PM Philippine time.

• Lunch break: One hour unpaid.

• Paid working hours: 40 hours per week.

• First 30 days: $3 USD per hour.

• After successful completion of the first 30 days: $4 USD per hour.

• Payments: According to an agreed schedule.

• Assigned onboarding, training, production work, and requested revisions are paid.



The increase to $4 per hour depends on:

• Reliable attendance and punctuality.

• Clear, prompt communication.

• Meeting deadlines.

• Accurate captions and written work.

• Correct branding.

• Proper file organization.

• Following instructions.

• Demonstrating progress and applying feedback.



You must be available and responsive during scheduled working hours. Please disclose any existing commitments that could interfere with this schedule.



TRAINING AND PRODUCTION EXPECTATIONS



We will provide onboarding, examples, and checklists.



Training may include:

• CapCut and OpusClip workflows.

• Selecting strong interview moments.

• Caption correction and branding.

• Spotify setup and publishing procedures.

• Riverside recording and file handling.

• Production tracking and quality checks.

• Client communication and approval procedures.



After training, our initial planning target for approximately three standard vertical shorts is 60–90 minutes, depending on the recording and editing required.



Highlight videos, account setup, episode publishing, and more involved assignments will have separate time allowances. Expectations will be refined using actual production results.



Accuracy, sound judgment, and consistent improvement matter.



PROFESSIONAL NOTICE AND HANDOVER



We expect respectful communication and professional conduct.



If you d
 to resign, please provide at least two weeks’ written notice before your final working day, except where an emergency makes this impractical.



During your notice period, you are expected to:

• Complete agreed priorities.

• Update the production tracker.

• Organize and hand over source files, editable projects, and completed videos.

• Document outstanding tasks and deadlines.

• Assist with an orderly transition of assigned responsibilities.



Company and client accounts must remain under their respective owners’ control.



PAID SKILLS TEST



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a small paid test.



The test may include:

• Proofreading a short caption or episode description.

• Selecting a strong moment from an interview and explaining your choice.

• Creating one simple vertical clip, with instructions appropriate to your experience.

• Following a file-naming and organization checklist.



The test brief, expected work time, payment amount, and payment date will be agreed before you begin. You will have a 48-hour delivery window.



We will assess English accuracy, attention to detail, judgment, communication, and ability to follow instructions.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the words:



AUTHORITY EDITOR



Please include:



A short introduction explaining why you are a good fit.



Your relevant experience, including any administrative, podcast, content, or editing work.



Your experience with CapCut, OpusClip, Canva, Spotify for Creators, and Riverside. Be honest about which tools you have not used.



Links to relevant work samples, if available. Explain what you personally did. Applicants without editing samples may still be considered.



Your computer’s make, model, approximate age, processor, RAM, and available storage.



Your internet download and upload speeds, along with your backup plan for interruptions.



Confirmation that you have a quiet workspace, webcam, and microphone or headset for daily Zoom calls.



Confirmation that you can work Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM Philippine time.



Your current work commitments and earliest available start date.



A brief example of a work problem you encountered, what you did, and the result.



Confirmation that you accept $3 per hour for the first 30 days and $4 per hour after successfully completing the introductory period.



Confirmation that you agree to provide at least two weeks’ written notice if you resign, except in an emergency.



Please write your application in your own words. We want to understand how you communicate.



We are looking for someone who takes pride in accurate work, contributes positively to the team, and wants to build a dependable, long-term working relationship.

title: Video Editor for Real Estate (Singapore) - Shorts/Reels
description:
We are looking for a dedicated, seasoned Video Editor with a proven track record of executing engaging, high-retention videos.



We are a stable, established boutique Singapore-based real estate team. You will be working directly with a top-performing real estate agent, helping her turn a large volume of raw footage into polished, daily content.



Students need not apply. We are looking for a mature, career-oriented professional who wants to build a long-term career with a growing company, not someone looking for a temporary gig.



The Role:

As a Full-Time Video Editor, you will be responsible for producing high-quality video content that aligns with our brand's vision.



She has a large backlog of raw footage. To start, your primary KPI will be to edit, deliver, and post one captivating short video per day (10-60 seconds) directly to her social platforms. In addition to the daily shorts, you will also be required to edit occasional long-form videos (e.g., property tours or deep dives) as needed.

We are starting you at one short video a day so you can get used to the workflow, but you should expect the daily target to scale up to two short videos per day (plus the occasional long-form video) in the coming months. We need someone who is ready to handle that volume once fully onboarded.



We aren't looking for over-the-top Hollywood effects—we need clean, engaging edits with good pacing, dynamic captions, and smooth punch-ins/zooms to keep the viewer hooked.



Responsibilities:

• Take raw talking-head and property footage and edit it into 1 (eventually 2) high-quality short videos per day, plus occasional long-form videos.

• Act as her social media publisher: you will be fully responsible for uploading, writing captions, scheduling, and posting the finalized videos on her behalf across her platforms (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube).

Requirements:

• Minimum 3+ years of professional experience (we are looking for a reliable, seasoned professional).

• Proficiency in video editing software (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, CapCut Pro, or similar tools).

title: IT Project Manager
description:
Job Description

The Project Manager (PM) at Intelligent Technical Solutions (ITS) leads client-facing technology projects in a fast-paced Managed Services Provider (MSP) environment. This role is responsible for managing multiple small-to-medium IT projects simultaneously including client onboarding, Microsoft 365 migrations, infrastructure refreshes, network upgrades, and cybersecurity deployments. 

The PM ensures all projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with both client expectations and ITS’s service standards. Working closely with technical teams, account managers, and service delivery leaders, the PM drives clear communication, structured execution, and exceptional client experience from kickoff to handoff. 



Job Responsibilities

Project Ownership & Execution 

Plan, coordinate, and deliver IT projects for SMB clients such as server/cloud migrations, security stack deployments, and network infrastructure upgrades.

Manage multiple concurrent projects using ConnectWise Manage.

Define project scope, tasks, timelines, and resource assignments using ITS templates and standards.

Track and communicate project milestones, dependencies, and risks with clients and internal teams.

Ensure seamless handoff to Service Delivery or Support once projects are completed. 



Stakeholder Engagement 

Serve as the primary point of contact for clients during project execution, ensuring consistent communication and expectation management.

Partner with Account Managers, vCIOs, and Technical Leads to align project objectives with client needs.

Conduct kickoff, status, and closeout meetings with internal and external stakeholders.

Ensure partners and vendors are informed of relevant project milestones and deliverables. 



Team Leadership & Risk Management 

Coordinate efforts across engineering, procurement, and service delivery teams to maintain accountability and progress.

Identify, document, and mitigate risks before they impact schedule or quality.

Proactively manage change requests and ensure project documentation remains current.

Uphold ITS’s quality standards and process discipline across all project engagements. 



What Success Looks Like 

Projects delivered on schedule and within defined scope.

Clients express high satisfaction with project communication and outcomes.

Internal handoffs to Service Delivery occur smoothly and without rework.

Documentation is complete, standardized, and audit-ready.

Cross-departmental collaboration and visibility are consistently strong.



Job Qualifications

3+ years of project management experience within a Managed Services Provider (MSP) or IT consulting firm.

Proven success managing multiple concurrent client projects of varying scope and complexity.

Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, cloud technologies (especially Microsoft 365 and Azure), and cybersecurity best practices.

Experience managing client onboarding, technology refresh, or environment migration projects.

Proficiency with ConnectWise Manage, and documentation tools like IT Glue.

title: Social Media Content Creator (Reels, Video Editing & Graphic Design)
description:
Organization: 48 Social, an offering of SpiritualTech Systems

Start Date: Immediate

Location: Remote



About 48 Social



48 Social helps spiritual teachers and conscious creators turn their teachings into a consistent, authentic social presence without becoming full-time content creators. It is created by SpiritualTech Systems, a nonprofit whose mission is to bring spiritual enlightenment to the world through technology and advanced systems.



We believe social media doesn't have to amplify comparison and distraction. It can amplify consciousness too.



About the Role



We're looking for a Social Media Content Creator who is both skilled in video and energetically aware: someone who can blend editing precision with an intuitive understanding of a teacher's essence.



Much of your work will be creating reels from live event footage: retreats, gatherings, talks, and ceremonies with the teachers we support. We provide the event footage, B-roll, and long-form teachings. You'll be the guardian of each client's energy and brand, making sure every reel and every graphic feels like them.



What You'll Do



- Create reels from event footage: recap reels, highlight moments, teaching clips, and atmosphere pieces that let someone who wasn't in the room feel what it was like to be there.



- Sort through large batches of raw event footage and B-roll to find the moments worth sharing.



- Create short-form reels from long-form teachings, using event B-roll to enrich them.



- Edit video end to end: selecting moments, cutting, pacing, captions, music, and color.



- Design social media assets such as quote posts, quote reels, carousels, covers, and thumbnails.



- Preserve each client's unique voice, tone, and visual energy in every piece, so that nothing goes out that doesn't feel aligned.



- Adapt content to each platform, so the message stays the same while the expression changes.



Essential Skills & Experience



- Strong video editing skills, with a portfolio of short-form reels.



- Experience editing event footage, including mixed-quality sources (phone clips alongside professional video).



- The ability to build a story from unscripted footage, with no shot list to follow.



- Solid graphic design fundamentals: layout, typography, color harmony, and hierarchy.



- An understanding of what performs on short-form platforms, including hooks, pacing, and on-screen text.



- The ability to capture and express diverse brand voices, especially in the conscious, wellness, and spiritual spaces.



- High attention to detail and a habit of catching inconsistencies others might miss.



- Clear communication and reliability with deadlines.





Required Tools

- Video editing (Descript, CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar)

- Canva (intermediate to advanced)

- Comfort learning new systems quickly, including our own platform



The Intangible Must-Haves



This role isn't just about editing. It's about energy alignment.



It requires someone intuitive and energetically aware. Our clients are conscious creators: coaches, healers, spiritual teachers, and wellness practitioners. You need to feel and understand the energy behind their brands, not just follow a checklist. If you naturally pick up on vibes, understand authentic messaging, and can sense when something feels "off" or "on," you'll thrive here.



You're a fit if you:



- Naturally sense when an edit "feels right," and keep working until it does.



- Can watch hours of event footage and recognize the ten seconds that carry the feeling of the whole day.



- Know that the wrong music, pacing, or trend can distort a teacher's presence, and choose accordingly.



- Protect a client's authenticity even when a trendier option would be easier.



- Bring emotional intelligence and intuition into your creative process.



Ideal Candidate



- Has their own practice or experience with spirituality, meditation, or conscious business brands.



- Moves fluidly between multiple brand aesthetics without blending them together.



- Balances speed with precision.



- Takes pride in delivering polished, high-quality work.



- Thrives in a fast-paced but calm, organized environment.



- Sees both the big picture and the frame-level details.



Why Join Us



- Work remotely with a mission-driven creative team.



- Work with footage from inspiring spiritual teachers and live events.



- Contribute your talent to a cause that uplifts humanity.



- Grow your creative skills within a values-aligned organization.



How to Apply



If you're an intuitive, detail-oriented creator who understands both video and energy, we'd love to meet you. Send your portfolio or 3–5 sample reels, along with a short note on why this work speaks to you, to 



Compensation



- Starts at $5/hour, part-time.

- Significant room to grow as the role expands toward full-time and as your work with our clients deepens.

- This is an early-stage, mission-driven opportunity rather than a fixed-rate position: your pay grows alongside the role.



Ready to Join Our Mission?



If you're an organized, intuitive social media professional who understands the energy and voice of conscious creators, we want to hear from you. This is your opportunity to be part of something meaningful while growing your skills in a supportive, values-aligned environment.



Apply now — we're ready to hire immediately!

title: Customer Support Phone Agent, US Brand (Remote, Part-Time)
description:

Start date: As soon as possible



About the Role:



We run live phone support for our US webshop. Right now we receive around 20 calls a day (roughly 2–3 per hour), and we expect this volume to grow significantly over the coming weeks, so comfort with a fast-growing call queue is essential.



Every call is a chance to help a customer and a chance to close a sale. You'll answer inbound calls covering both existing-order questions (status, returns, exchanges, shipping) and new sales enquiries, and you'll be expected to actively guide callers toward completing their purchase, not just answer questions. Our goal is to answer 98%+ of all incoming calls.



Between calls, there will be downtime that can be used for related tasks such as
 support and call logging.



Responsibilities:

- Answer inbound customer calls on our phone line during your assigned shifts

- Advise customers on products, sizing, and fit, and actively close sales by creating a Shopify draft order for every closed sale

- Return missed calls and voi
s within 12 hours

- Handle customer
s during phone downtime, using our macro library for consistent responses

- Log every call accurately and same-day (call type, outcome, sale amount)

- Issue store credit or discount codes when resolving customer issues

- Escalate complex cases (disputes, shipment problems, VIP customers) following our escalation process

- Stay current on products, promotions, and policies, including during weeks you're not on shift



Requirements:

- Sales experience – for us, support is sales. You must be comfortable advising a customer and then actively asking for and closing the sale, not just answering the question

- US e-commerce experience, ideally hands-on creating draft orders in Shopify

- Neutral, US-friendly accent – our customers should feel they're speaking with someone based in the US

- Clear, friendly spoken and written English

- Genuine long-term availability during US Eastern business hours (9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST). For Philippines-based applicants, this is a permanent night shift (approximately 9:00 PM–5:00 AM or 10:00 PM–6:00 AM PHT, depending on US daylight saving time). Please only apply if you're comfortable with this long-term

- Experience with a helpdesk platform (Zendesk preferred) and confidence picking up new tools quickly (Quo, Rise AI, Shopify admin, Google Sheets)

- Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet work environment, and a quality headset

- Strong attention to detail for call logging and reporting



Nice to Have:

- Familiarity with footwear or apparel e-commerce (sizing, returns, exchanges)

- Prior on-call, relief, or reliever scheduling experience



Compensation:

- $5/hour base rate

- 7% commission on every phone sale you close (a sale counts once a draft order is created under your name and the customer completes payment)

- Commission is calculated from the call tracking sheet and paid with your regular monthly pay cycle

title: Virtual Receptionist

Demonstrated experience answering live inbound patient calls for a U.S. healthcare practice.

Hands-on experience booking and rescheduling patients inside an EHR.

Must be able to name the EHR system(s) used in previous healthcare roles.

Experience running a recall or reactivation workflow, including pulling a report/list, calling patients, and successfully rebooking them.

Experience performing insurance verification for a U.S. medical, dental, or clinical practice.

Strong spoken English that is clear and easily understood by American patients.

Excellent phone etiquette, listening skills, and patient communication.

Strong attention to detail and accurate data entry.

Ability to handle multiple calls, scheduling requests, and administrative tasks in a fast-paced environment.

Comfortable working independently in a remote setting.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.

Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Be part of an international, passionate team of educators.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

title: Senior Performance Marketing Specialist – Google Ads + Meta Ads | Australian Fitness Brand
description:
We are an Australian fitness company preparing to launch a new premium gym and wellness concept in Sydney.



We are looking for a senior Performance Marketing Specialist based in the Philippines to take ownership of our paid customer acquisition across Google Ads and Meta Ads.



This is not a VA role, social media posting role or junior media-buyer position.



We are looking for someone who understands the entire paid acquisition process:

Strategy → campaign → creative testing → landing page → lead → CRM → paying member → CAC



You will work directly with the business owners.



We already have professional Australian partners handling our branding, website, high-end photography/video production and ongoing social/content creation. You will not be expected to create all of the content yourself.



Your job is to determine how we use paid media to acquire members efficiently, identify what is and isn't working, and tell our creative team what additional ads/assets should be produced based on performance.



Your responsibilities



You will own our Google Ads and Meta Ads performance.

Google Ads

You should be highly experienced with:

- Google Search campaigns

- Keyword research and search-intent analysis

- Competitor research

- Negative keyword management

- Match-type strategy

- Campaign/ad-group structure

- Ad copy and testing

- Bidding strategy

- Budget allocation

- Conversion tracking

- Remarketing

- Local customer acquisition

- Google Business Profile/local considerations

- Ongoing search-term analysis and optimisation



We do not want someone who simply creates campaigns and checks them once per week.

We expect active optimisation and strategic recommendations.



Meta Ads

You should be highly experienced with:

-
 and Instagram advertising

- Lead-generation and conversion campaigns

- Prospecting

- Retargeting

- Audience testing

- Creative testing

- Hooks, angles and messaging

- Lead forms vs landing pages

- Campaign structure

- Budget optimisation

- Pixel + Conversions API

- Creative performance analysis



You should be able to look at campaign data and tell our content team:

“We need three more variations of this concept.”

or:

“This message is converting significantly better. Let's produce more content around this angle.”

You don't need to personally film or professionally design the content.

Strategy



We are specifically looking for someone who can think beyond Ads Manager.

We want your input on:

- Customer/audience segmentation

- Competitor advertising

- Membership acquisition offers

- Pre-opening campaigns

- Foundation-member campaigns

- Launch campaigns

- Lead-generation funnels

- Landing pages

- Retargeting strategy

- Channel budget allocation

- Creative testing strategy

- Conversion-rate optimisation

- Lead quality

- Cost per lead

- Cost per appointment/tour

- Cost per paying member

- Customer acquisition cost (CAC)



If you only report impressions, clicks, CTR and CPL, this position is probably not suitable.

Our primary goal is profitable paying members, not cheap leads.

Tracking & attribution



Strong experience with the following is highly desirable:

- Google Analytics 4

- Google Tag Manager

- Google Ads conversion tracking

- Enhanced Conversions

- Meta Pixel

- Meta Conversions API

- CRM conversion tracking

- Offline conversion tracking

- Looker Studio/reporting



Our membership-management platform is GymMaster.

We want to build attribution as far through the funnel as reasonably possible so we can understand:

Ad → Lead → Tour/Trial → Paid Membership



Experience connecting advertising platforms with CRMs or membership-management systems is highly desirable.

You do not necessarily need previous GymMaster experience if you have strong experience implementing similar CRM/offline conversion tracking.



Experience we're looking for



Ideally you have:



- 5+ years hands-on performance marketing experience

- Strong Google Ads experience

- Strong Meta Ads experience

- Experience with Australian businesses/consumers

- Local lead-generation experience

- Experience managing campaigns yourself, not only supervising junior staff

- Experience with GA4/GTM/tracking

- Experience analysing landing pages/funnels

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Strong analytical skills



Experience working for an Australian digital/performance marketing agency would be particularly valuable.

Experience with any of the following industries is also highly desirable:

Gyms, fitness studios, Pilates, wellness, health clubs, allied health, membership businesses or multi-location businesses.

Former Google/Meta agency or platform experience is also welcome, but demonstrable results matter more to us than job titles.



Our initial advertising budget

Initial paid media budget will likely be approximately:

A$3,000–A$5000+ per month

across Google and Meta.



This can increase substantially if we establish a profitable and scalable member acquisition model.

We are not looking to artificially restrict advertising spend. If campaigns demonstrate an acceptable cost per acquired member, we are prepared to scale.



This will initially be for one Sydney location, with the possibility of additional locations in the future.

Working arrangement



We are open to either:



Part-time ongoing employment

or

a fixed monthly retainer for the right senior candidate.



We are not looking for a full-service agency.



We want a skilled individual who can work directly with us and become our long-term paid acquisition specialist.

You will have access to the required advertising and analytics accounts through appropriate user permissions. Our company will retain ownership of all accounts, data and advertising assets.



How to apply



Please do NOT send a generic ChatGPT-generated cover letter.

Start your application with the words:

SYDNEY FITNESS

so we know you have read the entire job description.



Then answer the following:

1. How many years have you personally managed Google Ads?

2. How many years have you personally managed Meta Ads?

3. Have you managed campaigns targeting Australian customers? Give examples.

4. Have you worked for an Australian marketing agency? If yes, which type of clients did you manage?

5. Have you managed advertising for a gym, fitness studio, Pilates studio, wellness business or membership business? Please explain.

6. What is the approximate largest monthly advertising budget you have personally managed?

7. Give us one example of a lead-generation campaign where you can provide actual results. Include spend, leads/conversions and CPA/CAC where possible.

8. Explain your experience with GA4, GTM, Google conversion tracking, Meta Pixel and CAPI.

9. Have you implemented offline/CRM conversion tracking so Google or Meta can optimise toward actual customers rather than just leads?

10. Imagine we are opening a premium gym in Sydney in approximately 8 weeks. We have a professional website, high-quality photo/video assets and a A$6,000/month paid-media budget. In a few paragraphs, explain how you would approach the launch across Google and Meta.



Please also provide:

- Your OnlineJobs.ph profile

- CV/resume

- Relevant case studies

- Your expected monthly compensation/retainer

- Hours available per week

- Current number of clients/employers

- Earliest available start date



We are looking for someone interested in a long-term relationship, not simply someone to set up campaigns.

If you're excellent at performance marketing but don't personally create videos or graphic design, that's completely fine.



We already have professional creative resources.



What we need from you is the ability to determine:

Who should we target?

What should we advertise?

Where should we spend?

Which creative is working?

Why is it working?

What should we test next?

Which channel produces actual paying members?

How can we reduce member acquisition cost and scale?



If that's how you think about performance marketing, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Content Producer & Short-Form Video Editor — Luxury Beauty + Personal Brand
description:
We’re looking for a high-taste Content Producer and Short-Form Video Editor to create content for two distinct brands:



• A premium permanent makeup and luxury beauty brand

• A founder-led personal brand focused on life, love, identity, confidence, self-worth and personal transformation



This is not simply a video-cutting position.



We need someone who understands:



• Pacing

• Hooks

• Visual storytelling

• Audience retention

• Music and sound selection

• Clean text placement

• Brand identity

• Emotional impact

• What makes people stop scrolling



You should be able to take an approved concept, creative brief and source material and turn them into polished, post-ready content without needing every cut, transition or design choice explained to you.



You will not be responsible for filming or posting content.



Your primary responsibility will be producing and editing high-quality content from footage, images, templates, scripts and creative direction provided by our team.



THE TWO BRANDS



LUXURY BEAUTY BRAND



The beauty brand specializes in premium permanent makeup services.



Its content may include:



• Client transformations

• Before-and-after results

• Permanent brows

• Lip Blush

• Permanent Eyeliner

• Beauty education

• Service storytelling

• Luxury beauty experiences

• Promotional campaigns

• Selected AI-assisted cinematic campaigns



This brand’s content should feel:



• Polished

• Premium

• Clean

• Modern

• Feminine

• Intentional

• Results-focused

• Visually elevated



FOUNDER-LED PERSONAL BRAND



The personal brand focuses on:



• Life

• Love

• Identity

• Self-worth

• Standards and boundaries

• Personal transformation

• Honest storytelling

• Feminine confidence



This brand should feel natural, emotionally engaging and conversational—not overly produced or like a generic influencer page.



The right candidate must understand how to edit these two brands differently without blending their identities.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



You will produce short-form content for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.



Responsibilities may include:



• Reviewing creative briefs and source materials

• Selecting the strongest footage and moments

• Editing face-to-camera videos

• Editing beauty, service, lifestyle and transformation content

• Producing short story-driven videos

• Producing simple graphics and carousels using approved templates

• Creating strong openings and maintaining viewer attention

• Adding approved on-screen text, captions, music and sound effects

• Creating clean transitions and visual flow

• Repurposing strong source material into multiple useful assets when directed

• Using AI tools for selected creative and cinematic projects

• Organizing project files, source assets and final exports

• Following the assigned production queue and deadlines

• Reviewing your own work before submitting it

• Delivering complete, polished work rather than unfinished drafts



You will receive brand direction, creative briefs and priorities. You are expected to use independent editing judgment while remaining within the approved direction.



AI CONTENT EXPERIENCE



Not all content will be AI-generated.



Traditional editing, storytelling and content judgment are the foundation of this position.



However, familiarity with AI creative platforms is strongly preferred because selected campaigns will include AI-assisted imagery and cinematic video production.



Experience with tools such as the following is valuable:



• Higgsfield

• ChatGPT

• Image-generation platforms

• AI video-generation platforms

• CapCut AI tools



If you have produced AI-assisted advertisements, cinematic videos, character-consistent scenes or story-based campaigns, please include examples.



SCHEDULE AND EXPECTED WORK



This is a 20-hour-per-week position:



• 4 hours per day

• 5 days per week

• Monday through Friday



Weekly assignments will vary according to brand priorities and the complexity of each project.



Assignments may include:



• Standard short-form edits

• Face-to-camera videos

• Before-and-after content

• Graphics or carousels

• Campaign assets

• AI-assisted cinematic content



There is no inflexible daily production quota.



A complex AI cinematic assignment may replace several standard edits. We care about strong, useful output—not rushed work created simply to meet a content count.



YOU’RE A STRONG FIT IF YOU:



• Have strong CapCut experience

• Have experience editing TikTok, Reels or YouTube Shorts

• Understand hooks, pacing and viewer retention

• Have strong visual taste and aesthetic judgment

• Can edit both polished brand content and natural personal storytelling

• Can follow creative direction without requiring constant supervision

• Can make thoughtful editing decisions independently

• Know when an edit needs energy and when it needs restraint

• Care about spelling, timing, text placement and small details

• Can organize files and meet deadlines

• Accept feedback professionally

• Learn from revisions and avoid repeating the same mistakes

• Can work efficiently without sacrificing quality

• Communicate clearly and raise questions before they become delays



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF:



• You require frame-by-frame instructions for every edit

• Your work frequently feels cluttered, chaotic or over-edited

• You use effects and transitions without a clear purpose

• You make every brand look like the same social media template

• You rely on trends without understanding the brand

• You submit unfinished work and expect the company to complete it

• You repeatedly miss details already included in the brief

• You need constant reminders to meet deadlines

• You cannot distinguish between luxury beauty content and authentic personal storytelling

• You depend entirely on AI and lack traditional editing skills



REQUIRED SKILLS



• Strong CapCut experience

• Short-form video editing experience

• Strong understanding of hooks, pacing and retention

• Clean on-screen text and caption placement

• Strong visual storytelling ability

• Excellent attention to detail

• Dependable communication

• Ability to follow brand standards and creative briefs

• Reliable computer and internet connection

• Ability to work independently



PREFERRED SKILLS



• AI video or image-generation experience

• Higgsfield experience

• Beauty, lifestyle or luxury-brand experience

• Face-to-camera and personal-brand editing

• Story-driven or cinematic editing

• Canva experience

• Basic sound design

• Experience managing assignments in Asana or a similar project-management platform



COMPENSATION



• Starting rate: $5–$7 USD per hour

• Final starting rate will be based on demonstrated skill, portfolio quality and paid-trial performance

• 20 hours per week

• 90-day probationary period

• Performance reviews during the probationary period

• Opportunity for increased compensation, hours and responsibility based on demonstrated performance



The starting range will be applied as follows:



• $5/hour — developing candidate with strong potential who requires additional training or direction

• $6/hour — experienced candidate who produces strong traditional edits and requires limited direction

• $7/hour — advanced candidate who demonstrates excellent editing judgment, clear brand distinction, minimal revision needs and strong AI-production ability



Compensation growth will be based on:



• Quality of work

• Consistency

• Dependability

• Speed and efficiency

• Ability to follow direction

• Reduction in unnecessary revisions

• Independent judgment

• Ability to support both brands successfully

• Development and application of AI-production skills



SELECTION PROCESS



Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid trial assignment using our brand materials and direction.



The trial may include:



• One luxury beauty-brand edit

• One personal-brand edit

• A short AI-production exercise or review of your existing AI work



The purpose is to evaluate editing ability, creative judgment, attention to detail and your ability to distinguish between the two brands.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include all of the following:



A link to your three strongest short-form editing samples.



At least one face-to-camera or personal-storytelling sample.



At least one beauty, lifestyle, luxury or transformation-based sample.



Any AI-generated video, image or cinematic work you have created. If you do not have AI samples, state that honestly.



A list of the editing and AI tools you personally know how to use.



Your current availability and the hours you are available to work.



Your internet speed and computer specifications.



For every sample submitted, briefly explain what you personally handled.



Answer the following question in 4–6 sentences:



“How would you make the editing style feel different for a premium beauty-service brand versus an honest, personality-led storytelling brand?”



Begin your application with the words:



“I understand the difference.”



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow into a trusted, long-term creative team member—not someone searching for occasional editing work.

title: Senior Amazon PPC Specialist, Part-Time, Profit-Focused, Long-Term
description:
Position Details: 

• Hours: 15 to 20 hours per week, up to 25 in peak weeks (Prime events, Q4)

• Location: Remote, any location. Must be available 9am to 1pm US Eastern at least three days a week, plus live coverage on major sale events (Prime events, Black Friday, Cyber Monday)

• Rate: $12 to $20 per hour, based on experience

• Engagement: Long-term contract, reporting directly to company leadership



About the Role:

We are a US-based consumer products company selling across several Amazon marketplaces in North America, Europe and Australia. We manage advertising to profit, not to ACoS. Every SKU carries its own margin data, and a data pipeline produces a proposed change list each cycle. You own the judgment and execution on top of that pipeline: d
 what to approve, what to reject, and what the system missed. This is a senior seat for someone who has already run ads for multiple brands and wants a steady, long-term engagement.



What You Will Do:

• Run two change cycles per week across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display using bulk files and a system-generated change list

• Approve, reject or adjust proposed bid, budget and negative-targeting changes, with a short written reason for anything you change outside the proposed list

• Submit changes above a set dollar threshold for owner approval before they go live

• Own search-term harvesting, negative targeting, placement adjustments and new campaign builds

• Respond to daily pacing alerts: spend spikes, out-of-budget campaigns, low stock cover, zero-impression campaigns

• Review a weekly scorecard per account (spend, ad sales, total sales, profit after ads, TACoS, organic share) and write a short read of what changed and why

• Plan and pace event periods: Prime events, Black Friday and Cyber Monday



Requirements:

• 4+ years of hands-on Amazon Ads management across multiple brands or accounts

• Profit-based management, not ACoS alone: you can set targets from contribution margin and breakeven ACoS, reason about operating profit after ads and returns, and judge marginal ROAS on incremental spend. You can describe a time you cut spend because of it and profit went up

• Fluent with bulk sheets and large data exports (Excel or Google Sheets at a high level)

• Comfortable working inside an AI-assisted workflow: changes are proposed by a system, reviewed and edited by you, and approved above a dollar threshold by the owner

• Clear, concise written English

• Government-issued ID matching your contract name and payment account

• You do the work personally: no subcontracting, no shared accounts, time tracked under a single account



Nice to Have:

• Walmart Connect, Shopify or TikTok Shop ads experience

• Experience with Sellerise, Helium 10, Feedvisor or similar tools

• Jewelry, accessories, gifts or beauty categories



How to apply:

In your application, write two or three sentences about a time you reduced ad spend and profit went up. Include the numbers. Applications without this will not be reviewed.



Process:

1. Short application (see above)

2. One video interview with leadership

3. Paid test: $35 flat, about 90 minutes, working from an anonymized data export. Paid whether or not we move forward

4. Offer, contract and ID verification (government-issued ID matching your contract name and payment account)
